POUND.name: Pound
POUND.effect: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

KARATE_CHOP.name: Karate Chop
KARATE_CHOP.effect: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

DOUBLE_SLAP.name: Double Slap
DOUBLE_SLAP.effect: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, 2-5 times in a row.

COMET_PUNCH.name: Comet Punch
COMET_PUNCH.effect: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike 2-5 times in a row.

MEGA_PUNCH.name: Mega Punch
MEGA_PUNCH.effect: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

PAY_DAY.name: Pay Day
PAY_DAY.effect: Coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. If the target is successfully struck, you will earn money after the battle.

FIRE_PUNCH.name: Fire Punch
FIRE_PUNCH.effect: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target.

ICE_PUNCH.name: Ice Punch
ICE_PUNCH.effect: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This move has a 10% chance of freezing the target.

THUNDER_PUNCH.name: Thunder Punch
THUNDER_PUNCH.effect: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

SCRATCH.name: Scratch
SCRATCH.effect: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

VISE_GRIP.name: Vise Grip
VISE_GRIP.effect: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

GUILLOTINE.name: Guillotine
GUILLOTINE.effect: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits, unless it is a Boss Pokémon. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%.

RAZOR_WIND.name: Razor Wind
RAZOR_WIND.effect: The user attacks the turn after using this move with blades of wind. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SWORDS_DANCE.name: Swords Dance
SWORDS_DANCE.effect: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user’s Attack stat.

CUT.name: Cut
CUT.effect: The target is cut with a scythe, a claw, or the like to inflict damage.

GUST.name: Gust
GUST.effect: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage. This move can hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop with its power doubled.

WING_ATTACK.name: Wing Attack
WING_ATTACK.effect: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.effect: The user moves last and creates a strong wind. The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

FLY.name: Fly
FLY.effect: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

BIND.name: Bind
BIND.effect: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

SLAM.name: Slam
SLAM.effect: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

VINE_WHIP.name: Vine Whip
VINE_WHIP.effect: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

STOMP.name: Stomp
STOMP.effect: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

DOUBLE_KICK.name: Double Kick
DOUBLE_KICK.effect: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.

MEGA_KICK.name: Mega Kick
MEGA_KICK.effect: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

JUMP_KICK.name: Jump Kick
JUMP_KICK.effect: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

ROLLING_KICK.name: Rolling Kick
ROLLING_KICK.effect: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

SAND_ATTACK.name: Sand Attack
SAND_ATTACK.effect: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, lowering the target’s accuracy.

HEADBUTT.name: Headbutt
HEADBUTT.effect: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

HORN_ATTACK.name: Horn Attack
HORN_ATTACK.effect: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

FURY_ATTACK.name: Fury Attack
FURY_ATTACK.effect: The user attacks by jabbing the target with a horn, a beak, or the like. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

HORN_DRILL.name: Horn Drill
HORN_DRILL.effect: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits, unless it is a Boss Pokémon. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%.

TACKLE.name: Tackle
TACKLE.effect: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

BODY_SLAM.name: Body Slam
BODY_SLAM.effect: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

WRAP.name: Wrap
WRAP.effect: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

TAKE_DOWN.name: Take Down
TAKE_DOWN.effect: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

THRASH.name: Thrash
THRASH.effect: The user rampages and attacks for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

DOUBLE_EDGE.name: Double-Edge
DOUBLE_EDGE.effect: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

TAIL_WHIP.name: Tail Whip
TAIL_WHIP.effect: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.

POISON_STING.name: Poison Sting
POISON_STING.effect: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

TWINEEDLE.name: Twineedle
TWINEEDLE.effect: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. Each hit has a 20% chance of poisoning the target.

PIN_MISSILE.name: Pin Missile
PIN_MISSILE.effect: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

LEER.name: Leer
LEER.effect: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

BITE.name: Bite
BITE.effect: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

GROWL.name: Growl
GROWL.effect: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

ROAR.name: Roar
ROAR.effect: The user moves last and lets out a mighty roar. The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

SING.name: Sing
SING.effect: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

SUPERSONIC.name: Supersonic
SUPERSONIC.effect: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

SONIC_BOOM.name: Sonic Boom
SONIC_BOOM.effect: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

DISABLE.name: Disable
DISABLE.effect: For 4 turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.

ACID.name: Acid
ACID.effect: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This move has a 10% chance of lowering their Sp. Def stats.

EMBER.name: Ember
EMBER.effect: The target is attacked with small flames. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target.

FLAMETHROWER.name: Flamethrower
FLAMETHROWER.effect: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target.

MIST.name: Mist
MIST.effect: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for 5 turns.

WATER_GUN.name: Water Gun
WATER_GUN.effect: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

HYDRO_PUMP.name: Hydro Pump
HYDRO_PUMP.effect: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

SURF.name: Surf
SURF.effect: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave. This move’s power is doubled against targets submerged with Dive.

ICE_BEAM.name: Ice Beam
ICE_BEAM.effect: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This move has a 10% chance of freezing the target.

BLIZZARD.name: Blizzard
BLIZZARD.effect: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of freezing the target, and never misses in snow or hail.

PSYBEAM.name: Psybeam
PSYBEAM.effect: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This move has a 10% chance of confusing the target.

BUBBLE_BEAM.name: Bubble Beam
BUBBLE_BEAM.effect: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Speed stat.

AURORA_BEAM.name: Aurora Beam
AURORA_BEAM.effect: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Attack stat.

HYPER_BEAM.name: Hyper Beam
HYPER_BEAM.effect: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

PECK.name: Peck
PECK.effect: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

DRILL_PECK.name: Drill Peck
DRILL_PECK.effect: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

SUBMISSION.name: Submission
SUBMISSION.effect: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

LOW_KICK.name: Low Kick
LOW_KICK.effect: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 20 and 120).

COUNTER.name: Counter
COUNTER.effect: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

SEISMIC_TOSS.name: Seismic Toss
SEISMIC_TOSS.effect: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

STRENGTH.name: Strength
STRENGTH.effect: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

ABSORB.name: Absorb
ABSORB.effect: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

MEGA_DRAIN.name: Mega Drain
MEGA_DRAIN.effect: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

LEECH_SEED.name: Leech Seed
LEECH_SEED.effect: A seed is planted on the target. At the end of every turn, ⅛ of the target’s max HP gets absorbed by the user or any Pokémon that takes its place in battle.

GROWTH.name: Growth
GROWTH.effect: The user’s body grows all at once, boosting its Attack and Sp. Atk stats. In harsh sunlight, these stats will be boosted sharply instead.

RAZOR_LEAF.name: Razor Leaf
RAZOR_LEAF.effect: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SOLAR_BEAM.name: Solar Beam
SOLAR_BEAM.effect: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn. In harsh sunlight, the user can attack immediately. This move’s power is halved in any other weather condition.

POISON_POWDER.name: Poison Powder
POISON_POWDER.effect: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

STUN_SPORE.name: Stun Spore
STUN_SPORE.effect: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

SLEEP_POWDER.name: Sleep Powder
SLEEP_POWDER.effect: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.

PETAL_DANCE.name: Petal Dance
PETAL_DANCE.effect: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

STRING_SHOT.name: String Shot
STRING_SHOT.effect: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stat.

DRAGON_RAGE.name: Dragon Rage
DRAGON_RAGE.effect: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

FIRE_SPIN.name: Fire Spin
FIRE_SPIN.effect: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

THUNDER_SHOCK.name: Thunder Shock
THUNDER_SHOCK.effect: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

THUNDERBOLT.name: Thunderbolt
THUNDERBOLT.effect: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

THUNDER_WAVE.name: Thunder Wave
THUNDER_WAVE.effect: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

THUNDER.name: Thunder
THUNDER.effect: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target, and never misses in rain. This move can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop.

ROCK_THROW.name: Rock Throw
ROCK_THROW.effect: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

EARTHQUAKE.name: Earthquake
EARTHQUAKE.effect: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it. This move’s power is doubled against targets underground from Dig, and halved while Grassy Terrain is active.

FISSURE.name: Fissure
FISSURE.effect: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits, unless it is a Boss Pokémon. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%.

DIG.name: Dig
DIG.effect: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.effect: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. The target takes increasing poison damage at the end of every turn, starting at ¹⁄₁₆ of the Pokémon’s max HP, then ²⁄₁₆ and so on. If the user is a Poison-type, this move will never miss.

CONFUSION.name: Confusion
CONFUSION.effect: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This move has a 10% chance of confusing the target.

PSYCHIC.name: Psychic
PSYCHIC.effect: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

HYPNOSIS.name: Hypnosis
HYPNOSIS.effect: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

MEDITATE.name: Meditate
MEDITATE.effect: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body to boost the user’s Attack stat.

AGILITY.name: Agility
AGILITY.effect: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

QUICK_ATTACK.name: Quick Attack
QUICK_ATTACK.effect: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

RAGE.name: Rage
RAGE.effect: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage boosts the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.

TELEPORT.name: Teleport
TELEPORT.effect: The user moves last and switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.

NIGHT_SHADE.name: Night Shade
NIGHT_SHADE.effect: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

MIMIC.name: Mimic
MIMIC.effect: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.

SCREECH.name: Screech
SCREECH.effect: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

DOUBLE_TEAM.name: Double Team
DOUBLE_TEAM.effect: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.

RECOVER.name: Recover
RECOVER.effect: The user regenerates its cells, restoring ½ of its max HP.

HARDEN.name: Harden
HARDEN.effect: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.

MINIMIZE.name: Minimize
MINIMIZE.effect: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply boosts its evasiveness. However, this leaves the user more vulnerable to certain slamming and crushing moves.

SMOKESCREEN.name: Smokescreen
SMOKESCREEN.effect: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

CONFUSE_RAY.name: Confuse Ray
CONFUSE_RAY.effect: The user shines a sinister ray at the target, leaving it confused.

WITHDRAW.name: Withdraw
WITHDRAW.effect: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

DEFENSE_CURL.name: Defense Curl
DEFENSE_CURL.effect: The user curls up to conceal weak spots, which boosts its Defense stat. This also doubles the power of Rollout and Ice Ball.

BARRIER.name: Barrier
BARRIER.effect: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply boosts its Defense stat.

LIGHT_SCREEN.name: Light Screen
LIGHT_SCREEN.effect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from special moves for 5 turns. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

HAZE.name: Haze
HAZE.effect: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

REFLECT.name: Reflect
REFLECT.effect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from physical moves for 5 turns. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

FOCUS_ENERGY.name: Focus Energy
FOCUS_ENERGY.effect: The user takes a deep breath and focuses, gaining a 2-stage critical-hit ratio boost to its future attacks.

BIDE.name: Bide
BIDE.effect: The user endures attacks for 2 turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.effect: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

MIRROR_MOVE.name: Mirror Move
MIRROR_MOVE.effect: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move. This move fails if no other move has been used yet, or if the last move used cannot be copied.

SELF_DESTRUCT.name: Self-Destruct
SELF_DESTRUCT.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

EGG_BOMB.name: Egg Bomb
EGG_BOMB.effect: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

LICK.name: Lick
LICK.effect: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

SMOG.name: Smog
SMOG.effect: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This move has a 40% chance of poisoning the target.

SLUDGE.name: Sludge
SLUDGE.effect: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

BONE_CLUB.name: Bone Club
BONE_CLUB.effect: The user clubs the target with a bone. This move has a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

FIRE_BLAST.name: Fire Blast
FIRE_BLAST.effect: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target.

WATERFALL.name: Waterfall
WATERFALL.effect: The user attacks by charging at the target with incredible momentum. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

CLAMP.name: Clamp
CLAMP.effect: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

SWIFT.name: Swift
SWIFT.effect: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

SKULL_BASH.name: Skull Bash
SKULL_BASH.effect: The user tucks in its head to boost its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

SPIKE_CANNON.name: Spike Cannon
SPIKE_CANNON.effect: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit 2-5 times in a row.

CONSTRICT.name: Constrict
CONSTRICT.effect: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Speed stat.

AMNESIA.name: Amnesia
AMNESIA.effect: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user’s Sp. Def stat.

KINESIS.name: Kinesis
KINESIS.effect: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

SOFT_BOILED.name: Soft-Boiled
SOFT_BOILED.effect: The user produces itself a large egg, restoring ½ of its max HP.

HIGH_JUMP_KICK.name: High Jump Kick
HIGH_JUMP_KICK.effect: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

GLARE.name: Glare
GLARE.effect: The user intimidates the target with a frightful glare that will leave it paralyzed.

DREAM_EATER.name: Dream Eater
DREAM_EATER.effect: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

POISON_GAS.name: Poison Gas
POISON_GAS.effect: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

BARRAGE.name: Barrage
BARRAGE.effect: Round objects are hurled at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

LEECH_LIFE.name: Leech Life
LEECH_LIFE.effect: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

LOVELY_KISS.name: Lovely Kiss
LOVELY_KISS.effect: With a scary face, the user tries to kiss the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

SKY_ATTACK.name: Sky Attack
SKY_ATTACK.effect: The user attacks with a powered-up dive the turn after using this move. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage, and it has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

TRANSFORM.name: Transform
TRANSFORM.effect: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set. It also copies all of the target’s stats apart from its HP. Copied moves have 5 PP each.

BUBBLE.name: Bubble
BUBBLE.effect: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of lowering their Speed stats.

DIZZY_PUNCH.name: Dizzy Punch
DIZZY_PUNCH.effect: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

SPORE.name: Spore
SPORE.effect: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

FLASH.name: Flash
FLASH.effect: The user flashes a bright light that lowers the target’s accuracy.

PSYWAVE.name: Psywave
PSYWAVE.effect: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. This attack varies in damage, ranging from 50% to 150% of the user’s level.

SPLASH.name: Splash
SPLASH.effect: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all…

ACID_ARMOR.name: Acid Armor
ACID_ARMOR.effect: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

CRABHAMMER.name: Crabhammer
CRABHAMMER.effect: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
EXPLOSION.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

FURY_SWIPES.name: Fury Swipes
FURY_SWIPES.effect: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

BONEMERANG.name: Bonemerang
BONEMERANG.effect: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to damage the target twice—coming and going.

REST.name: Rest
REST.effect: The user goes to sleep for 2 turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and cures any status conditions. This move fails if the user’s HP is full.

ROCK_SLIDE.name: Rock Slide
ROCK_SLIDE.effect: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of making the targets flinch.

HYPER_FANG.name: Hyper Fang
HYPER_FANG.effect: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This move has a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

SHARPEN.name: Sharpen
SHARPEN.effect: The user makes its edges more jagged, which boosts its Attack stat.

CONVERSION.name: Conversion
CONVERSION.effect: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.

TRI_ATTACK.name: Tri Attack
TRI_ATTACK.effect: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This move has a 20% chance of leaving the target burned, frozen, or paralyzed.

SUPER_FANG.name: Super Fang
SUPER_FANG.effect: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

SLASH.name: Slash
SLASH.effect: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SUBSTITUTE.name: Substitute
SUBSTITUTE.effect: The user creates a substitute for itself by losing ¼ of its max HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy, and will vanish when it takes damage equal to the amount of HP lost by the user to create it.

STRUGGLE.name: Struggle
STRUGGLE.effect: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no remaining PP. The user loses ¼ of its max HP.

SKETCH.name: Sketch
SKETCH.effect: This move enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.

TRIPLE_KICK.name: Triple Kick
TRIPLE_KICK.effect: A consecutive three-kick attack that increases in power by 10 with each successive hit. When one kick misses, the move ends.

THIEF.name: Thief
THIEF.effect: The user attacks and tries to steal from the target simultaneously. This move has a 30% chance to steal one of the target’s held items.

SPIDER_WEB.name: Spider Web
SPIDER_WEB.effect: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee or be switched out from battle.

MIND_READER.name: Mind Reader
MIND_READER.effect: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

NIGHTMARE.name: Nightmare
NIGHTMARE.effect: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts damage equal to ¼ of its max HP at the end of every turn. This fails if the target is not asleep.

FLAME_WHEEL.name: Flame Wheel
FLAME_WHEEL.effect: The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

SNORE.name: Snore
SNORE.effect: If the user is asleep, it attacks with a harsh noise. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

CURSE.name: Curse
CURSE.effect: The user boosts its Attack and Defense stats in exchange for lowering its Speed stat. If the user is a Ghost type, it instead loses ½ of its max HP to inflict a curse on the target. A Pokémon inflicted by the curse loses ¼ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

FLAIL.name: Flail
FLAIL.effect: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 20 and 200).

CONVERSION_2.name: Conversion 2
CONVERSION_2.effect: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the move the target used last.

AEROBLAST.name: Aeroblast
AEROBLAST.effect: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

COTTON_SPORE.name: Cotton Spore
COTTON_SPORE.effect: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

REVERSAL.name: Reversal
REVERSAL.effect: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has (ranging between 20 and 200).

SPITE.name: Spite
SPITE.effect: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

POWDER_SNOW.name: Powder Snow
POWDER_SNOW.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This move has a 10% chance of freezing targets.

PROTECT.name: Protect
PROTECT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

MACH_PUNCH.name: Mach Punch
MACH_PUNCH.effect: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

SCARY_FACE.name: Scary Face
SCARY_FACE.effect: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

FEINT_ATTACK.name: Feint Attack
FEINT_ATTACK.effect: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

SWEET_KISS.name: Sweet Kiss
SWEET_KISS.effect: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

BELLY_DRUM.name: Belly Drum
BELLY_DRUM.effect: The user loses ½ of its max HP to maximize its Attack stat. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

SLUDGE_BOMB.name: Sludge Bomb
SLUDGE_BOMB.effect: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

MUD_SLAP.name: Mud-Slap
MUD_SLAP.effect: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

OCTAZOOKA.name: Octazooka
OCTAZOOKA.effect: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

SPIKES.name: Spikes
SPIKES.effect: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team, damaging opposing Pokémon that switch into battle for damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP. This damage increases with multiple layers of Spikes, up to a max of 3. Flying types or Pokémon with Levitate are unaffected.

ZAP_CANNON.name: Zap Cannon
ZAP_CANNON.effect: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

FORESIGHT.name: Foresight
FORESIGHT.effect: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

DESTINY_BOND.name: Destiny Bond
DESTINY_BOND.effect: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move fails if used in succession. Boss Pokémon are immune to this move.

PERISH_SONG.name: Perish Song
PERISH_SONG.effect: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in 3 turns, unless it switches out of battle. Boss Pokémon are immune to this move.

ICY_WIND.name: Icy Wind
ICY_WIND.effect: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

DETECT.name: Detect
DETECT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

BONE_RUSH.name: Bone Rush
BONE_RUSH.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

LOCK_ON.name: Lock-On
LOCK_ON.effect: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the user’s next move does not miss that target.

OUTRAGE.name: Outrage
OUTRAGE.effect: The user rampages and attacks for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

SANDSTORM.name: Sandstorm
SANDSTORM.effect: The user summons a sandstorm for 5 turns, Pokémon that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types take damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP at the end of every turn. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types by 50%.

GIGA_DRAIN.name: Giga Drain
GIGA_DRAIN.effect: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

ENDURE.name: Endure
ENDURE.effect: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

CHARM.name: Charm
CHARM.effect: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target’s Attack stat.

ROLLOUT.name: Rollout
ROLLOUT.effect: The user continually rolls into the target over 5 turns. This attack doubles in power each time it hits, and resets after 5 turns have passed or if the move is interrupted.

FALSE_SWIPE.name: False Swipe
FALSE_SWIPE.effect: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

SWAGGER.name: Swagger
SWAGGER.effect: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target’s Attack stat.

MILK_DRINK.name: Milk Drink
MILK_DRINK.effect: The user drinks highly nutritious milk, restoring ½ of its max HP.

SPARK.name: Spark
SPARK.effect: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

FURY_CUTTER.name: Fury Cutter
FURY_CUTTER.effect: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This move’s power is doubled if it hits in succession, up to a max of 160 power, and resets if this move is interrupted or another move is used.

STEEL_WING.name: Steel Wing
STEEL_WING.effect: The target is hit with wings of steel. This move has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Defense stat.

MEAN_LOOK.name: Mean Look
MEAN_LOOK.effect: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee or be switched out of battle.

ATTRACT.name: Attract
ATTRACT.effect: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will have a 50% chance of being unable to use its moves.

SLEEP_TALK.name: Sleep Talk
SLEEP_TALK.effect: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

HEAL_BELL.name: Heal Bell
HEAL_BELL.effect: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

RETURN.name: Return
RETURN.effect: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer (ranging between 1 and 102).

PRESENT.name: Present
PRESENT.effect: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap, randomly dealing damage with 40, 80, or 120 power. The gift restores ¼ of the target’s max HP sometimes, however.

FRUSTRATION.name: Frustration
FRUSTRATION.effect: This full-power attack grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer (ranging between 1 and 102).

SAFEGUARD.name: Safeguard
SAFEGUARD.effect: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for 5 turns.

PAIN_SPLIT.name: Pain Split
PAIN_SPLIT.effect: The user adds its remaining HP to the target’s remaining HP, then splits the total in half for them to share. Boss Pokémon are immune to this move.

SACRED_FIRE.name: Sacred Fire
SACRED_FIRE.effect: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This move has a 50% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

MAGNITUDE.name: Magnitude
MAGNITUDE.effect: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies based on the magnitude of the quake, with the possibility of being 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, or 150 power. This move’s power is doubled against targets underground from Dig, and halved while Grassy Terrain is active.

DYNAMIC_PUNCH.name: Dynamic Punch
DYNAMIC_PUNCH.effect: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.

MEGAHORN.name: Megahorn
MEGAHORN.effect: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

DRAGON_BREATH.name: Dragon Breath
DRAGON_BREATH.effect: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

BATON_PASS.name: Baton Pass
BATON_PASS.effect: The user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon. If the user had any stat changes, a substitute, or other such effects, they will be passed on to the Pokémon switching in.

ENCORE.name: Encore
ENCORE.effect: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for 3 turns.

PURSUIT.name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.effect: The power of this attack move is doubled if it’s used on a target that’s switching out of battle.

RAPID_SPIN.name: Rapid Spin
RAPID_SPIN.effect: The user performs a spin attack that can eliminate the effects of binding moves and Leech Seed, as well as any entry hazards on its side. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

SWEET_SCENT.name: Sweet Scent
SWEET_SCENT.effect: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness.

IRON_TAIL.name: Iron Tail
IRON_TAIL.effect: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

METAL_CLAW.name: Metal Claw
METAL_CLAW.effect: The target is raked with steel claws. This move has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack stat.

VITAL_THROW.name: Vital Throw
VITAL_THROW.effect: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

MORNING_SUN.name: Morning Sun
MORNING_SUN.effect: The user bathes in the pleasant rays of the sun, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

SYNTHESIS.name: Synthesis
SYNTHESIS.effect: The user produces energy through photosynthesis, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

MOONLIGHT.name: Moonlight
MOONLIGHT.effect: The user bathes in the soothing light of the moon, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

HIDDEN_POWER.name: Hidden Power
HIDDEN_POWER.effect: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.

CROSS_CHOP.name: Cross Chop
CROSS_CHOP.effect: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

TWISTER.name: Twister
TWISTER.effect: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This move has a 20% chance of making the targets flinch, and can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop with its power doubled.

RAIN_DANCE.name: Rain Dance
RAIN_DANCE.effect: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for 5 turns, powering up Water-type moves by 50%. The rain also halves the damage dealt by Fire-type moves.

SUNNY_DAY.name: Sunny Day
SUNNY_DAY.effect: The user intensifies the sun for 5 turns, powering up Fire-type moves by 50%. The sunlight also halves the damage dealt by Water-type moves.

CRUNCH.name: Crunch
CRUNCH.effect: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

MIRROR_COAT.name: Mirror Coat
MIRROR_COAT.effect: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.

PSYCH_UP.name: Psych Up
PSYCH_UP.effect: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

EXTREME_SPEED.name: Extreme Speed
EXTREME_SPEED.effect: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

ANCIENT_POWER.name: Ancient Power
ANCIENT_POWER.effect: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats all at once.

SHADOW_BALL.name: Shadow Ball
SHADOW_BALL.effect: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

FUTURE_SIGHT.name: Future Sight
FUTURE_SIGHT.effect: 2 turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

ROCK_SMASH.name: Rock Smash
ROCK_SMASH.effect: The user attacks with a punch. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

WHIRLPOOL.name: Whirlpool
WHIRLPOOL.effect: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn. This move’s power is doubled against targets submerged with Dive.

BEAT_UP.name: Beat Up
BEAT_UP.effect: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target, attacking as many times as the number of healthy Pokémon in the user’s party. This move’s power is calculated based on the Attack stats of the party Pokémon.

FAKE_OUT.name: Fake Out
FAKE_OUT.effect: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

UPROAR.name: Uproar
UPROAR.effect: The user attacks in an uproar for 3 turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

STOCKPILE.name: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.effect: The user raises its Stockpiling level by 1 and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to 3 times.

SPIT_UP.name: Spit Up
SPIT_UP.effect: The levels stored using the move Stockpile are released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 100 and 300).

SWALLOW.name: Swallow
SWALLOW.effect: The levels stored using the move Stockpile are absorbed by the user to restore its HP. Level 1: ¼ of the user’s max HP is restored. Level 2: ½ of the user’s max HP is restored. Level 3: The user’s HP is fully restored.

HEAT_WAVE.name: Heat Wave
HEAT_WAVE.effect: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of burning targets.

HAIL.name: Hail
HAIL.effect: The user summons a hailstorm lasting 5 turns. All Pokémon except Ice types will be damaged for ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP at the end of every turn.

TORMENT.name: Torment
TORMENT.effect: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

FLATTER.name: Flatter
FLATTER.effect: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

WILL_O_WISP.name: Will-O-Wisp
WILL_O_WISP.effect: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

MEMENTO.name: Memento
MEMENTO.effect: The user faints. In return, the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.

FACADE.name: Facade
FACADE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the user is poisoned, badly poisoned, burned, or paralyzed. Although this move is a physical move, the damage it deals is not halved when the user is burned.

FOCUS_PUNCH.name: Focus Punch
FOCUS_PUNCH.effect: The user moves last to focus its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

SMELLING_SALTS.name: Smelling Salts
SMELLING_SALTS.effect: This attack’s power is doubled when used on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target’s paralysis, however.

FOLLOW_ME.name: Follow Me
FOLLOW_ME.effect: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.

NATURE_POWER.name: Nature Power
NATURE_POWER.effect: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the biome or terrain this move was used in.

CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.effect: The user becomes charged, doubling the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Def stat.

TAUNT.name: Taunt
TAUNT.effect: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for 3 turns.

HELPING_HAND.name: Helping Hand
HELPING_HAND.effect: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally’s attack by 50%.

TRICK.name: Trick
TRICK.effect: The user catches the target off guard and swaps a target’s held item with its own.

ROLE_PLAY.name: Role Play
ROLE_PLAY.effect: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target’s Ability.

WISH.name: Wish
WISH.effect: One turn after this move is used, the user’s or its replacement’s HP is restored by ½ the user’s max HP

ASSIST.name: Assist
ASSIST.effect: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by ally Pokémon.

INGRAIN.name: Ingrain
INGRAIN.effect: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it cannot flee or be switched out.

SUPERPOWER.name: Superpower
SUPERPOWER.effect: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

MAGIC_COAT.name: Magic Coat
MAGIC_COAT.effect: Until the end of the turn, certain non-damaging moves directed at the user are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.

RECYCLE.name: Recycle
RECYCLE.effect: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

REVENGE.name: Revenge
REVENGE.effect: The user moves last. The power of this move is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

BRICK_BREAK.name: Brick Break
BRICK_BREAK.effect: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.

YAWN.name: Yawn
YAWN.effect: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

KNOCK_OFF.name: Knock Off
KNOCK_OFF.effect: The user slaps down a target’s held item, removing the item. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the target has a held item.

ENDEAVOR.name: Endeavor
ENDEAVOR.effect: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target’s HP to roughly equal the user’s HP. This fails if the target’s HP is the same as or lower than the user’s. Boss Pokémon are immune to this move.

ERUPTION.name: Eruption
ERUPTION.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

SKILL_SWAP.name: Skill Swap
SKILL_SWAP.effect: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

IMPRISON.name: Imprison
IMPRISON.effect: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

REFRESH.name: Refresh
REFRESH.effect: The user rests to cure itself of poisoning, a burn, or paralysis.

GRUDGE.name: Grudge
GRUDGE.effect: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.

SNATCH.name: Snatch
SNATCH.effect: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing or stat-changing move.

SECRET_POWER.name: Secret Power
SECRET_POWER.effect: The additional effects of this attack depend upon the biome or terrain it was used in.

DIVE.name: Dive
DIVE.effect: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.

ARM_THRUST.name: Arm Thrust
ARM_THRUST.effect: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

CAMOUFLAGE.name: Camouflage
CAMOUFLAGE.effect: The user’s type is changed depending on the biome or terrain this move was used in.

TAIL_GLOW.name: Tail Glow
TAIL_GLOW.effect: The user flashes bright lights as it focuses its mind, drastically boosting its Sp. Atk stat.

LUSTER_PURGE.name: Luster Purge
LUSTER_PURGE.effect: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

MIST_BALL.name: Mist Ball
MIST_BALL.effect: The user attacks with a ball packed with mist-like down. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

FEATHER_DANCE.name: Feather Dance
FEATHER_DANCE.effect: The user covers the target’s body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

TEETER_DANCE.name: Teeter Dance
TEETER_DANCE.effect: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.

BLAZE_KICK.name: Blaze Kick
BLAZE_KICK.effect: The user attacks with a kick that has a 10% chance of burning the target. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

MUD_SPORT.name: Mud Sport
MUD_SPORT.effect: The user kicks up mud on the battlefield. This weakens Electric-type moves for 5 turns.

ICE_BALL.name: Ice Ball
ICE_BALL.effect: The user continually rolls into the target over 5 turns. This attack doubles in power each time it hits, and resets after 5 turns have passed or if the move is interrupted.

NEEDLE_ARM.name: Needle Arm
NEEDLE_ARM.effect: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

SLACK_OFF.name: Slack Off
SLACK_OFF.effect: The user slacks off, restoring ½ of its max HP.

HYPER_VOICE.name: Hyper Voice
HYPER_VOICE.effect: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

POISON_FANG.name: Poison Fang
POISON_FANG.effect: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This move has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.

CRUSH_CLAW.name: Crush Claw
CRUSH_CLAW.effect: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

BLAST_BURN.name: Blast Burn
BLAST_BURN.effect: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can’t move on the next turn.

HYDRO_CANNON.name: Hydro Cannon
HYDRO_CANNON.effect: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can’t move on the next turn.

METEOR_MASH.name: Meteor Mash
METEOR_MASH.effect: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This move has a 20% chance of boosting the user’s Attack stat.

ASTONISH.name: Astonish
ASTONISH.effect: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

WEATHER_BALL.name: Weather Ball
WEATHER_BALL.effect: This move’s type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

AROMATHERAPY.name: Aromatherapy
AROMATHERAPY.effect: The user releases a soothing scent to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

FAKE_TEARS.name: Fake Tears
FAKE_TEARS.effect: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

AIR_CUTTER.name: Air Cutter
AIR_CUTTER.effect: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

OVERHEAT.name: Overheat
OVERHEAT.effect: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

ODOR_SLEUTH.name: Odor Sleuth
ODOR_SLEUTH.effect: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

ROCK_TOMB.name: Rock Tomb
ROCK_TOMB.effect: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

SILVER_WIND.name: Silver Wind
SILVER_WIND.effect: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by the wind. This also has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats all at once.

METAL_SOUND.name: Metal Sound
METAL_SOUND.effect: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

GRASS_WHISTLE.name: Grass Whistle
GRASS_WHISTLE.effect: The user plays a pleasant melody that puts the target to sleep.

TICKLE.name: Tickle
TICKLE.effect: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.

COSMIC_POWER.name: Cosmic Power
COSMIC_POWER.effect: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

WATER_SPOUT.name: Water Spout
WATER_SPOUT.effect: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

SIGNAL_BEAM.name: Signal Beam
SIGNAL_BEAM.effect: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. This move has a 10% chance of confusing the target.

SHADOW_PUNCH.name: Shadow Punch
SHADOW_PUNCH.effect: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.

EXTRASENSORY.name: Extrasensory
EXTRASENSORY.effect: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This move has a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

SKY_UPPERCUT.name: Sky Uppercut
SKY_UPPERCUT.effect: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force. This move can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop.

SAND_TOMB.name: Sand Tomb
SAND_TOMB.effect: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

SHEER_COLD.name: Sheer Cold
SHEER_COLD.effect: The target is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target faints instantly if this attack hits, unless it is a Boss Pokémon. This move does not affect Ice types. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%. If used by Pokémon other than Ice types, the accuracy of this move is 20%.

MUDDY_WATER.name: Muddy Water
MUDDY_WATER.effect: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This move has a 30% chance of lowering their accuracy.

BULLET_SEED.name: Bullet Seed
BULLET_SEED.effect: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

AERIAL_ACE.name: Aerial Ace
AERIAL_ACE.effect: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

ICICLE_SPEAR.name: Icicle Spear
ICICLE_SPEAR.effect: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

IRON_DEFENSE.name: Iron Defense
IRON_DEFENSE.effect: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

BLOCK.name: Block
BLOCK.effect: The user blocks the target’s way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing or switching out of battle.

HOWL.name: Howl
HOWL.effect: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

DRAGON_CLAW.name: Dragon Claw
DRAGON_CLAW.effect: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

FRENZY_PLANT.name: Frenzy Plant
FRENZY_PLANT.effect: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

BULK_UP.name: Bulk Up
BULK_UP.effect: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

BOUNCE.name: Bounce
BOUNCE.effect: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

MUD_SHOT.name: Mud Shot
MUD_SHOT.effect: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

POISON_TAIL.name: Poison Tail
POISON_TAIL.effect: The user hits the target with its tail. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage and has a 10% chance of poisoning the target.

COVET.name: Covet
COVET.effect: The user endearingly approaches the target, then tries to steal from the target. This move has a 30% chance to steal one of the target’s held items.

VOLT_TACKLE.name: Volt Tackle
VOLT_TACKLE.effect: The user electrifies itself and charges the target to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move. This also has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

MAGICAL_LEAF.name: Magical Leaf
MAGICAL_LEAF.effect: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

WATER_SPORT.name: Water Sport
WATER_SPORT.effect: The user soaks the battlefield with water. This weakens Fire-type moves for 5 turns.

CALM_MIND.name: Calm Mind
CALM_MIND.effect: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

LEAF_BLADE.name: Leaf Blade
LEAF_BLADE.effect: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

DRAGON_DANCE.name: Dragon Dance
DRAGON_DANCE.effect: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

ROCK_BLAST.name: Rock Blast
ROCK_BLAST.effect: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

SHOCK_WAVE.name: Shock Wave
SHOCK_WAVE.effect: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

WATER_PULSE.name: Water Pulse
WATER_PULSE.effect: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

DOOM_DESIRE.name: Doom Desire
DOOM_DESIRE.effect: 2 turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.

PSYCHO_BOOST.name: Psycho Boost
PSYCHO_BOOST.effect: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

ROOST.name: Roost
ROOST.effect: The user lands and rests its body, restoring ½ of its max HP. If the user is a Flying type, it will lose the Flying type for the turn.

GRAVITY.name: Gravity
GRAVITY.effect: Boosts the accuracy of moves by 67% and grounds Pokémon such as Flying types or ones with the Levitate Ability for 5 turns. Moves that involve flying cannot be used.

MIRACLE_EYE.name: Miracle Eye
MIRACLE_EYE.effect: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

WAKE_UP_SLAP.name: Wake-Up Slap
WAKE_UP_SLAP.effect: This move’s power is doubled on a sleeping target. This also wakes the target up, however.

HAMMER_ARM.name: Hammer Arm
HAMMER_ARM.effect: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Speed stat.

GYRO_BALL.name: Gyro Ball
GYRO_BALL.effect: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

HEALING_WISH.name: Healing Wish
HEALING_WISH.effect: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.

BRINE.name: Brine
BRINE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the target’s HP is at half or less.

NATURAL_GIFT.name: Natural Gift
NATURAL_GIFT.effect: The user draws power to attack by using a held Berry. The Berry determines the move’s type and power.

FEINT.name: Feint
FEINT.effect: This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

PLUCK.name: Pluck
PLUCK.effect: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

TAILWIND.name: Tailwind
TAILWIND.effect: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that doubles the Speed stats of itself and its allies for 4 turns.

ACUPRESSURE.name: Acupressure
ACUPRESSURE.effect: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies’ stats.

METAL_BURST.name: Metal Burst
METAL_BURST.effect: The user retaliates to deal 1.5x the damage it took from an opponent’s move during the turn this move is used.

U_TURN.name: U-turn
U_TURN.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

CLOSE_COMBAT.name: Close Combat
CLOSE_COMBAT.effect: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

PAYBACK.name: Payback
PAYBACK.effect: The user stores power, then attacks. This move’s power is doubled if the user moves after the target.

ASSURANCE.name: Assurance
ASSURANCE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

EMBARGO.name: Embargo
EMBARGO.effect: This move prevents the target from using its held items for 5 turns.

FLING.name: Fling
FLING.effect: The user flings one of its held items at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

PSYCHO_SHIFT.name: Psycho Shift
PSYCHO_SHIFT.effect: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.

TRUMP_CARD.name: Trump Card
TRUMP_CARD.effect: This move’s power starts at 40 and increases as its remaining PP decreases: 50 at 4 PP, 60 at 3 PP, 80 at 2 PP, and 200 at 1 PP. This move never misses.

HEAL_BLOCK.name: Heal Block
HEAL_BLOCK.effect: For 5 turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

WRING_OUT.name: Wring Out
WRING_OUT.effect: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 120).

POWER_TRICK.name: Power Trick
POWER_TRICK.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.

GASTRO_ACID.name: Gastro Acid
GASTRO_ACID.effect: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability and Passive.

LUCKY_CHANT.name: Lucky Chant
LUCKY_CHANT.effect: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits for 5 turns.

ME_FIRST.name: Me First
ME_FIRST.effect: The user cuts ahead of the target to copy and use the target’s intended move, boosting its power by 50%. This move fails if it isn’t used first.

COPYCAT.name: Copycat
COPYCAT.effect: The user mimics the move that was last used. This move fails if no other move has been used yet, or if the last move used cannot be copied.

POWER_SWAP.name: Power Swap
POWER_SWAP.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

GUARD_SWAP.name: Guard Swap
GUARD_SWAP.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

PUNISHMENT.name: Punishment
PUNISHMENT.effect: This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the target’s stats have been boosted.

LAST_RESORT.name: Last Resort
LAST_RESORT.effect: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

WORRY_SEED.name: Worry Seed
WORRY_SEED.effect: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target’s Ability Insomnia.

SUCKER_PUNCH.name: Sucker Punch
SUCKER_PUNCH.effect: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

TOXIC_SPIKES.name: Toxic Spikes
TOXIC_SPIKES.effect: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. One layer will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle, while a second layer will badly poison them instead. Flying types or Pokémon with Levitate are unaffected. Poison-types that lands on these spikes will absorb and remove them from the field.

HEART_SWAP.name: Heart Swap
HEART_SWAP.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

AQUA_RING.name: Aqua Ring
AQUA_RING.effect: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

MAGNET_RISE.name: Magnet Rise
MAGNET_RISE.effect: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for 5 turns.

FLARE_BLITZ.name: Flare Blitz
FLARE_BLITZ.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move. This also has a 10% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

FORCE_PALM.name: Force Palm
FORCE_PALM.effect: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

AURA_SPHERE.name: Aura Sphere
AURA_SPHERE.effect: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

ROCK_POLISH.name: Rock Polish
ROCK_POLISH.effect: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user’s Speed stat.

POISON_JAB.name: Poison Jab
POISON_JAB.effect: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

DARK_PULSE.name: Dark Pulse
DARK_PULSE.effect: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

NIGHT_SLASH.name: Night Slash
NIGHT_SLASH.effect: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

AQUA_TAIL.name: Aqua Tail
AQUA_TAIL.effect: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

SEED_BOMB.name: Seed Bomb
SEED_BOMB.effect: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

AIR_SLASH.name: Air Slash
AIR_SLASH.effect: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

X_SCISSOR.name: X-Scissor
X_SCISSOR.effect: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

BUG_BUZZ.name: Bug Buzz
BUG_BUZZ.effect: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

DRAGON_PULSE.name: Dragon Pulse
DRAGON_PULSE.effect: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

DRAGON_RUSH.name: Dragon Rush
DRAGON_RUSH.effect: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

POWER_GEM.name: Power Gem
POWER_GEM.effect: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

DRAIN_PUNCH.name: Drain Punch
DRAIN_PUNCH.effect: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

VACUUM_WAVE.name: Vacuum Wave
VACUUM_WAVE.effect: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

FOCUS_BLAST.name: Focus Blast
FOCUS_BLAST.effect: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

ENERGY_BALL.name: Energy Ball
ENERGY_BALL.effect: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

BRAVE_BIRD.name: Brave Bird
BRAVE_BIRD.effect: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

EARTH_POWER.name: Earth Power
EARTH_POWER.effect: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

SWITCHEROO.name: Switcheroo
SWITCHEROO.effect: The user trades a held item with the target faster than the eye can follow.

GIGA_IMPACT.name: Giga Impact
GIGA_IMPACT.effect: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

NASTY_PLOT.name: Nasty Plot
NASTY_PLOT.effect: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

BULLET_PUNCH.name: Bullet Punch
BULLET_PUNCH.effect: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

AVALANCHE.name: Avalanche
AVALANCHE.effect: The user moves last. The power of this move is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

ICE_SHARD.name: Ice Shard
ICE_SHARD.effect: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

SHADOW_CLAW.name: Shadow Claw
SHADOW_CLAW.effect: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

THUNDER_FANG.name: Thunder Fang
THUNDER_FANG.effect: The user bites with electrified fangs. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

ICE_FANG.name: Ice Fang
ICE_FANG.effect: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This move has a 10% chance of freezing the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

FIRE_FANG.name: Fire Fang
FIRE_FANG.effect: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

SHADOW_SNEAK.name: Shadow Sneak
SHADOW_SNEAK.effect: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

MUD_BOMB.name: Mud Bomb
MUD_BOMB.effect: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

PSYCHO_CUT.name: Psycho Cut
PSYCHO_CUT.effect: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

ZEN_HEADBUTT.name: Zen Headbutt
ZEN_HEADBUTT.effect: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

MIRROR_SHOT.name: Mirror Shot
MIRROR_SHOT.effect: The user lets loose a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

FLASH_CANNON.name: Flash Cannon
FLASH_CANNON.effect: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

ROCK_CLIMB.name: Rock Climb
ROCK_CLIMB.effect: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

DEFOG.name: Defog
DEFOG.effect: A strong wind blows away the target’s barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, or Safeguard, as well as any entry hazards or terrain from the field. This also lowers the target’s evasiveness, and can clear deep fog.

TRICK_ROOM.name: Trick Room
TRICK_ROOM.effect: The user moves last and creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for 5 turns.

DRACO_METEOR.name: Draco Meteor
DRACO_METEOR.effect: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

DISCHARGE.name: Discharge
DISCHARGE.effect: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing targets.

LAVA_PLUME.name: Lava Plume
LAVA_PLUME.effect: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This move has a 30% chance of burning targets.

LEAF_STORM.name: Leaf Storm
LEAF_STORM.effect: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

POWER_WHIP.name: Power Whip
POWER_WHIP.effect: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

ROCK_WRECKER.name: Rock Wrecker
ROCK_WRECKER.effect: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can’t move on the next turn.

CROSS_POISON.name: Cross Poison
CROSS_POISON.effect: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that has a 10% chance of poisoning the target. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

GUNK_SHOT.name: Gunk Shot
GUNK_SHOT.effect: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

IRON_HEAD.name: Iron Head
IRON_HEAD.effect: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

MAGNET_BOMB.name: Magnet Bomb
MAGNET_BOMB.effect: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.

STONE_EDGE.name: Stone Edge
STONE_EDGE.effect: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

CAPTIVATE.name: Captivate
CAPTIVATE.effect: If any opposing Pokémon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.

STEALTH_ROCK.name: Stealth Rock
STEALTH_ROCK.effect: The user lays a trap of levitating stones, damaging opposing Pokémon that switch into battle equal to ⅛ of their max HP. This damage differs depending on the Pokémon’s type matchup with the Rock type.

GRASS_KNOT.name: Grass Knot
GRASS_KNOT.effect: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 20 and 120).

CHATTER.name: Chatter
CHATTER.effect: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This also confuses the target.

JUDGMENT.name: Judgment
JUDGMENT.effect: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move’s type changes depending on the kind of Plate or Memory Disc the user is holding, if it has the Multitype or RKS System ability.

BUG_BITE.name: Bug Bite
BUG_BITE.effect: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

CHARGE_BEAM.name: Charge Beam
CHARGE_BEAM.effect: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity has a 70% chance of boosting the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

WOOD_HAMMER.name: Wood Hammer
WOOD_HAMMER.effect: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

AQUA_JET.name: Aqua Jet
AQUA_JET.effect: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

ATTACK_ORDER.name: Attack Order
ATTACK_ORDER.effect: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

DEFEND_ORDER.name: Defend Order
DEFEND_ORDER.effect: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, boosting its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

HEAL_ORDER.name: Heal Order
HEAL_ORDER.effect: The user calls out its underlings to heal it, restoring ½ of its max HP.

HEAD_SMASH.name: Head Smash
HEAD_SMASH.effect: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. The user takes ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

DOUBLE_HIT.name: Double Hit
DOUBLE_HIT.effect: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.

ROAR_OF_TIME.name: Roar of Time
ROAR_OF_TIME.effect: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can’t move on the next turn.

SPACIAL_REND.name: Spacial Rend
SPACIAL_REND.effect: The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

LUNAR_DANCE.name: Lunar Dance
LUNAR_DANCE.effect: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP and PP restored and its status conditions cured.

CRUSH_GRIP.name: Crush Grip
CRUSH_GRIP.effect: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 120).

MAGMA_STORM.name: Magma Storm
MAGMA_STORM.effect: The user traps the target inside a maelstrom of fire. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

DARK_VOID.name: Dark Void
DARK_VOID.effect: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that puts them to sleep.

SEED_FLARE.name: Seed Flare
SEED_FLARE.effect: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This move has a 40% chance of harshly lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

OMINOUS_WIND.name: Ominous Wind
OMINOUS_WIND.effect: The user attacks with a gust of horrible wind that makes the target’s skin crawl. This has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats all at once.

SHADOW_FORCE.name: Shadow Force
SHADOW_FORCE.effect: The user disappears on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn. This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

HONE_CLAWS.name: Hone Claws
HONE_CLAWS.effect: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

WIDE_GUARD.name: Wide Guard
WIDE_GUARD.effect: During the turn this move is used, the user protects its side from moves that target all allies.

GUARD_SPLIT.name: Guard Split
GUARD_SPLIT.effect: The user employs its psychic power to add its Defense and Sp. Def stats to the target’s, then splits the total in half for them to share.

POWER_SPLIT.name: Power Split
POWER_SPLIT.effect: The user employs its psychic power to add its Attack and Sp. Atk stats to the target’s, then splits the total in half for them to share.

WONDER_ROOM.name: Wonder Room
WONDER_ROOM.effect: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for 5 turns.

PSYSHOCK.name: Psyshock
PSYSHOCK.effect: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

VENOSHOCK.name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.effect: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

AUTOTOMIZE.name: Autotomize
AUTOTOMIZE.effect: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter. This sharply boosts the user’s Speed stat.

RAGE_POWDER.name: Rage Powder
RAGE_POWDER.effect: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.

TELEKINESIS.name: Telekinesis
TELEKINESIS.effect: The user makes the target float with its psychic power for 3 turns. The target is immune to Ground-type moves while floating, but moves used against it are sure to hit (except for one-hit KO moves).

MAGIC_ROOM.name: Magic Room
MAGIC_ROOM.effect: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for 5 turns.

SMACK_DOWN.name: Smack Down
SMACK_DOWN.effect: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. This move can hit opposing Pokémon that are in the air, including those using Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop, knocking them down to the ground.

STORM_THROW.name: Storm Throw
STORM_THROW.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

FLAME_BURST.name: Flame Burst
FLAME_BURST.effect: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. Pokémon next to the target also take damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP.

SLUDGE_WAVE.name: Sludge Wave
SLUDGE_WAVE.effect: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This move has a 10% chance of poisoning targets.

QUIVER_DANCE.name: Quiver Dance
QUIVER_DANCE.effect: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

HEAVY_SLAM.name: Heavy Slam
HEAVY_SLAM.effect: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 40 and 120). If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

SYNCHRONOISE.name: Synchronoise
SYNCHRONOISE.effect: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.

ELECTRO_BALL.name: Electro Ball
ELECTRO_BALL.effect: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The higher the user’s Speed stat compared to the target’s, the greater this move’s power (ranging between 40 and 150).

SOAK.name: Soak
SOAK.effect: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target’s type to Water.

FLAME_CHARGE.name: Flame Charge
FLAME_CHARGE.effect: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

COIL.name: Coil
COIL.effect: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

LOW_SWEEP.name: Low Sweep
LOW_SWEEP.effect: The user makes a swift attack on the target’s legs, which lowers the target’s Speed stat.

ACID_SPRAY.name: Acid Spray
ACID_SPRAY.effect: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

FOUL_PLAY.name: Foul Play
FOUL_PLAY.effect: The user turns the target’s strength against it. The damage dealt by this move is determined using the target’s Attack stat instead of the user’s Attack stat.

SIMPLE_BEAM.name: Simple Beam
SIMPLE_BEAM.effect: The user emits a mysterious psychic wave that changes the target’s Ability to Simple.

ENTRAINMENT.name: Entrainment
ENTRAINMENT.effect: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.

AFTER_YOU.name: After You
AFTER_YOU.effect: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

ROUND.name: Round
ROUND.effect: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be doubled.

ECHOED_VOICE.name: Echoed Voice
ECHOED_VOICE.effect: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. This move’s power is increased by 40 each turn this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, up to a max of 200.

CHIP_AWAY.name: Chip Away
CHIP_AWAY.effect: Looking for an opening, the user strikes consistently. This move ignores the target’s stat changes when dealing damage.
