CLEAR_SMOG.name: Clear Smog
CLEAR_SMOG.effect: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.

STORED_POWER.name: Stored Power
STORED_POWER.effect: The user attacks the target with stored power. This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the user’s stats have been boosted.

QUICK_GUARD.name: Quick Guard
QUICK_GUARD.effect: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.

ALLY_SWITCH.name: Ally Switch
ALLY_SWITCH.effect: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

SCALD.name: Scald
SCALD.effect: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.

SHELL_SMASH.name: Shell Smash
SHELL_SMASH.effect: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

HEAL_PULSE.name: Heal Pulse
HEAL_PULSE.effect: The user emits a healing pulse that restores ½ of the target’s max HP.

HEX.name: Hex
HEX.effect: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

SKY_DROP.name: Sky Drop
SKY_DROP.effect: The user takes the target into the sky on the first turn, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

SHIFT_GEAR.name: Shift Gear
SHIFT_GEAR.effect: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.

CIRCLE_THROW.name: Circle Throw
CIRCLE_THROW.effect: The user attacks last. In return, the target is thrown and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

INCINERATE.name: Incinerate
INCINERATE.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

QUASH.name: Quash
QUASH.effect: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

ACROBATICS.name: Acrobatics
ACROBATICS.effect: The user nimbly strikes the target. The fewer held items, the higher the damage it inflicts (ranging between 55 and 110).

REFLECT_TYPE.name: Reflect Type
REFLECT_TYPE.effect: The user reflects the target’s type to become the same type as the target.

RETALIATE.name: Retaliate
RETALIATE.effect: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move’s power is doubled if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

FINAL_GAMBIT.name: Final Gambit
FINAL_GAMBIT.effect: The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its remaining HP at the time this move was used.

BESTOW.name: Bestow
BESTOW.effect: The user passes a held item to the target.

INFERNO.name: Inferno
INFERNO.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

WATER_PLEDGE.name: Water Pledge
WATER_PLEDGE.effect: A column of water hits the target. When used alongside Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a rainbow or vast swamp, respectively, for 4 turns.

FIRE_PLEDGE.name: Fire Pledge
FIRE_PLEDGE.effect: A column of fire hits the target. When used alongside Water Pledge or Grass Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a rainbow or vast sea of fire, respectively, for 4 turns.

GRASS_PLEDGE.name: Grass Pledge
GRASS_PLEDGE.effect: A column of grass hits the target. When used alongside Water Pledge or Fire Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a vast swamp or sea of fire, respectively, for 4 turns.

VOLT_SWITCH.name: Volt Switch
VOLT_SWITCH.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

STRUGGLE_BUG.name: Struggle Bug
STRUGGLE_BUG.effect: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

BULLDOZE.name: Bulldoze
BULLDOZE.effect: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

FROST_BREATH.name: Frost Breath
FROST_BREATH.effect: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.

DRAGON_TAIL.name: Dragon Tail
DRAGON_TAIL.effect: The user attacks last. In return, the target is knocked away and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

WORK_UP.name: Work Up
WORK_UP.effect: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.

ELECTROWEB.name: Electroweb
ELECTROWEB.effect: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

WILD_CHARGE.name: Wild Charge
WILD_CHARGE.effect: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

DRILL_RUN.name: Drill Run
DRILL_RUN.effect: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

DUAL_CHOP.name: Dual Chop
DUAL_CHOP.effect: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

HEART_STAMP.name: Heart Stamp
HEART_STAMP.effect: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

HORN_LEECH.name: Horn Leech
HORN_LEECH.effect: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

SACRED_SWORD.name: Sacred Sword
SACRED_SWORD.effect: The user attacks by slicing with a sword. This move ignores the target’s stat changes when dealing damage.

RAZOR_SHELL.name: Razor Shell
RAZOR_SHELL.effect: The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

HEAT_CRASH.name: Heat Crash
HEAT_CRASH.effect: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 40 and 120). If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

LEAF_TORNADO.name: Leaf Tornado
LEAF_TORNADO.effect: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

STEAMROLLER.name: Steamroller
STEAMROLLER.effect: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

COTTON_GUARD.name: Cotton Guard
COTTON_GUARD.effect: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

NIGHT_DAZE.name: Night Daze
NIGHT_DAZE.effect: The user looses a pitch-black shock wave at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 40% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

PSYSTRIKE.name: Psystrike
PSYSTRIKE.effect: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

TAIL_SLAP.name: Tail Slap
TAIL_SLAP.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

HURRICANE.name: Hurricane
HURRICANE.effect: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target, and never misses in rain. This move can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop.

HEAD_CHARGE.name: Head Charge
HEAD_CHARGE.effect: The user charges its head into the target, using its powerful guard hair. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

GEAR_GRIND.name: Gear Grind
GEAR_GRIND.effect: The user attacks by throwing steel gears at the target twice in a row.

SEARING_SHOT.name: Searing Shot
SEARING_SHOT.effect: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This move has a 30% chance of burning targets.

TECHNO_BLAST.name: Techno Blast
TECHNO_BLAST.effect: The user attacks by firing a beam of light at the target. When used by Genesect, this move’s type changes depending on the Drive being held.

RELIC_SONG.name: Relic Song
RELIC_SONG.effect: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep. If used by Meloetta, it will cause it to swap between its Aria and Pirouette Formes.

SECRET_SWORD.name: Secret Sword
SECRET_SWORD.effect: The user attacks by slashing targets with a long sword. The odd power contained in the sword does physical damage to the target. If a Keldeo knows this move, it will transform into its Resolute form.

GLACIATE.name: Glaciate
GLACIATE.effect: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Speed stats.

BOLT_STRIKE.name: Bolt Strike
BOLT_STRIKE.effect: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This move has a 20% chance of paralyzing the target.

BLUE_FLARE.name: Blue Flare
BLUE_FLARE.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This move has a 20% chance of burning the target.

FIERY_DANCE.name: Fiery Dance
FIERY_DANCE.effect: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and attacks the target. This move has a 50% chance of boosting the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

FREEZE_SHOCK.name: Freeze Shock
FREEZE_SHOCK.effect: The turn after using this move, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

ICE_BURN.name: Ice Burn
ICE_BURN.effect: The turn after using this move, the user surrounds the target with an ultracold, freezing wind to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target.

SNARL.name: Snarl
SNARL.effect: The user snarls incessantly at targets, lowering the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

ICICLE_CRASH.name: Icicle Crash
ICICLE_CRASH.effect: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

V_CREATE.name: V-create
V_CREATE.effect: The user emits a hot flame from its forehead and hurls itself at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

FUSION_FLARE.name: Fusion Flare
FUSION_FLARE.effect: The user brings down a giant flame. This move’s power is doubled if used after Fusion Bolt. The user is thawed out if it is frozen.

FUSION_BOLT.name: Fusion Bolt
FUSION_BOLT.effect: The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This move’s power is doubled if used after Fusion Flare.

FLYING_PRESS.name: Flying Press
FLYING_PRESS.effect: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

MAT_BLOCK.name: Mat Block
MAT_BLOCK.effect: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.

BELCH.name: Belch
BELCH.effect: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

ROTOTILLER.name: Rototiller
ROTOTILLER.effect: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This boosts the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of all grounded Grass-type Pokémon in battle.

STICKY_WEB.name: Sticky Web
STICKY_WEB.effect: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team. Pokémon that switch into battle will have their Speed stats lowered. Pokémon such as Flying types or ones with the Levitate Ability are unaffected.

FELL_STINGER.name: Fell Stinger
FELL_STINGER.effect: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat is boosted drastically.

PHANTOM_FORCE.name: Phantom Force
PHANTOM_FORCE.effect: The user attacks by disappearing into the shadows for a short time, then surfacing to strike the target on the next turn. This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

TRICK_OR_TREAT.name: Trick-or-Treat
TRICK_OR_TREAT.effect: The user invites targets to go trick-or-treating. This adds the Ghost type to the target’s type.

NOBLE_ROAR.name: Noble Roar
NOBLE_ROAR.effect: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

ION_DELUGE.name: Ion Deluge
ION_DELUGE.effect: The user disperses electrically charged particles, which changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

PARABOLIC_CHARGE.name: Parabolic Charge
PARABOLIC_CHARGE.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a wave of electricity. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

FORESTS_CURSE.name: Forest’s Curse
FORESTS_CURSE.effect: The user places the curse of the forest on targets. This adds the Grass type to the target’s type.

PETAL_BLIZZARD.name: Petal Blizzard
PETAL_BLIZZARD.effect: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

FREEZE_DRY.name: Freeze-Dry
FREEZE_DRY.effect: The user attacks by rapidly lowering target’s temperature. This move is also super effective against Water type Pokémon.

DISARMING_VOICE.name: Disarming Voice
DISARMING_VOICE.effect: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

PARTING_SHOT.name: Parting Shot
PARTING_SHOT.effect: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats. The user then switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.

TOPSY_TURVY.name: Topsy-Turvy
TOPSY_TURVY.effect: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

DRAINING_KISS.name: Draining Kiss
DRAINING_KISS.effect: The user steals the target’s HP with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by ¾ of the damage dealt by this move.

CRAFTY_SHIELD.name: Crafty Shield
CRAFTY_SHIELD.effect: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.

FLOWER_SHIELD.name: Flower Shield
FLOWER_SHIELD.effect: The user boosts the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

GRASSY_TERRAIN.name: Grassy Terrain
GRASSY_TERRAIN.effect: Turns the entire field into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns. Pokémon on the ground have the power of their Grass-type moves boosted by 30% and they have ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP restored at the end of every turn.

MISTY_TERRAIN.name: Misty Terrain
MISTY_TERRAIN.effect: Turns the entire field into Misty Terrain for 5 turns. Pokémon on the ground have the power of their Dragon-type moves halved, they are immune to status conditions, and they cannot become confused.

ELECTRIFY.name: Electrify
ELECTRIFY.effect: If this move hits the target before it uses a move, its move becomes Electric type for that turn.

PLAY_ROUGH.name: Play Rough
PLAY_ROUGH.effect: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Attack stat.

FAIRY_WIND.name: Fairy Wind
FAIRY_WIND.effect: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.

MOONBLAST.name: Moonblast
MOONBLAST.effect: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This move has 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

BOOMBURST.name: Boomburst
BOOMBURST.effect: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

FAIRY_LOCK.name: Fairy Lock
FAIRY_LOCK.effect: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out of battle during the next turn.

KINGS_SHIELD.name: King’s Shield
KINGS_SHIELD.effect: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn will have their Attack stats lowered. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

PLAY_NICE.name: Play Nice
PLAY_NICE.effect: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

CONFIDE.name: Confide
CONFIDE.effect: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

DIAMOND_STORM.name: Diamond Storm
DIAMOND_STORM.effect: The user attacks by engulfing targets in a storm of diamonds. This move has a 50% chance to sharply boost the user’s Defense stat.

STEAM_ERUPTION.name: Steam Eruption
STEAM_ERUPTION.effect: The user attacks by immersing targets in superheated steam. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.

HYPERSPACE_HOLE.name: Hyperspace Hole
HYPERSPACE_HOLE.effect: The user attacks by using a hyperspace hole to appear right near targets without warning. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

WATER_SHURIKEN.name: Water Shuriken
WATER_SHURIKEN.effect: The user hits the target with throwing stars 2-5 times in a row. This move always goes first. When used by Ash-Greninja, this move’s power is increased to 20 and will always strike 3 times in a row.

MYSTICAL_FIRE.name: Mystical Fire
MYSTICAL_FIRE.effect: The user attacks by breathing a special kind of searing flame. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

SPIKY_SHIELD.name: Spiky Shield
SPIKY_SHIELD.effect: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

AROMATIC_MIST.name: Aromatic Mist
AROMATIC_MIST.effect: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

EERIE_IMPULSE.name: Eerie Impulse
EERIE_IMPULSE.effect: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

VENOM_DRENCH.name: Venom Drench
VENOM_DRENCH.effect: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

POWDER.name: Powder
POWDER.effect: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and the target takes damages equal to ¼ of their max HP.

GEOMANCY.name: Geomancy
GEOMANCY.effect: The user absorbs energy on the first turn, then sharply boosts its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.

MAGNETIC_FLUX.name: Magnetic Flux
MAGNETIC_FLUX.effect: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.

HAPPY_HOUR.name: Happy Hour
HAPPY_HOUR.effect: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.

ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.name: Electric Terrain
ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.effect: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

DAZZLING_GLEAM.name: Dazzling Gleam
DAZZLING_GLEAM.effect: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

CELEBRATE.name: Celebrate
CELEBRATE.effect: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

HOLD_HANDS.name: Hold Hands
HOLD_HANDS.effect: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.

BABY_DOLL_EYES.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
BABY_DOLL_EYES.effect: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target’s Attack stat. This move always goes first.

NUZZLE.name: Nuzzle
NUZZLE.effect: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This paralyzes the target.

HOLD_BACK.name: Hold Back
HOLD_BACK.effect: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.

INFESTATION.name: Infestation
INFESTATION.effect: The target is infested and attacked. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn. The target can’t flee or be switched out of battle during this time.

POWER_UP_PUNCH.name: Power-Up Punch
POWER_UP_PUNCH.effect: The user attacks targets with a punch that will make its own fist tougher. This boosts the user’s Attack stat.

OBLIVION_WING.name: Oblivion Wing
OBLIVION_WING.effect: The user unleashes a wave of destruction to absorb HP from target. The user’s HP is restored by ¾ of the damage dealt by this move.

THOUSAND_ARROWS.name: Thousand Arrows
THOUSAND_ARROWS.effect: The user attacks by generating countless arrows from its internal energy and raining them down upon targets. This move can hit opposing Pokémon that are in the air, including those using Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop, knocking them down to the ground.

THOUSAND_WAVES.name: Thousand Waves
THOUSAND_WAVES.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a wave that crawls along the ground. Any Pokémon hit by the wave cannot flee or be switched out of battle.

LANDS_WRATH.name: Land’s Wrath
LANDS_WRATH.effect: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to inflict damage.

LIGHT_OF_RUIN.name: Light of Ruin
LIGHT_OF_RUIN.effect: Drawing in mystical energy, the user fires a powerful beam of light. The user takes ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

ORIGIN_PULSE.name: Origin Pulse
ORIGIN_PULSE.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

PRECIPICE_BLADES.name: Precipice Blades
PRECIPICE_BLADES.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

DRAGON_ASCENT.name: Dragon Ascent
DRAGON_ASCENT.effect: After soaring upward, the user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

HYPERSPACE_FURY.name: Hyperspace Fury
HYPERSPACE_FURY.effect: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. This also lowers the user’s Defense stat.

BREAKNECK_BLITZ__PHYSICAL.name: Breakneck Blitz
BREAKNECK_BLITZ__PHYSICAL.effect: The user builds up its momentum using its Z-Power and crashes into the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.

ALL_OUT_PUMMELING__PHYSICAL.name: All-Out Pummeling
ALL_OUT_PUMMELING__PHYSICAL.effect: The user rams an energy orb created by its Z-Power into the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

SUPERSONIC_SKYSTRIKE__PHYSICAL.name: Supersonic Skystrike
SUPERSONIC_SKYSTRIKE__PHYSICAL.effect: The user soars up with its Z-Power and plummets toward the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.

ACID_DOWNPOUR__PHYSICAL.name: Acid Downpour
ACID_DOWNPOUR__PHYSICAL.effect: The user creates a poisonous swamp using its Z-Power and sinks the target into it at full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

TECTONIC_RAGE__PHYSICAL.name: Tectonic Rage
TECTONIC_RAGE__PHYSICAL.effect: The user burrows deep into the ground and slams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

CONTINENTAL_CRUSH__PHYSICAL.name: Continental Crush
CONTINENTAL_CRUSH__PHYSICAL.effect: The user summons a huge rock mountain using its Z-Power and drops it onto the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

SAVAGE_SPIN_OUT__PHYSICAL.name: Savage Spin-Out
SAVAGE_SPIN_OUT__PHYSICAL.effect: The user binds the target with full force with threads of silk that the user spits using its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

NEVER_ENDING_NIGHTMARE__PHYSICAL.name: Never-Ending Nightmare
NEVER_ENDING_NIGHTMARE__PHYSICAL.effect: Deep-seated grudges summoned by the user’s Z-Power trap the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.

CORKSCREW_CRASH__PHYSICAL.name: Corkscrew Crash
CORKSCREW_CRASH__PHYSICAL.effect: The user spins very fast and rams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

INFERNO_OVERDRIVE__PHYSICAL.name: Inferno Overdrive
INFERNO_OVERDRIVE__PHYSICAL.effect: The user breathes a stream of intense fire toward the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies depending on the original move.

HYDRO_VORTEX__PHYSICAL.name: Hydro Vortex
HYDRO_VORTEX__PHYSICAL.effect: The user creates a huge whirling current using its Z-Power to swallow the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

BLOOM_DOOM__PHYSICAL.name: Bloom Doom
BLOOM_DOOM__PHYSICAL.effect: The user collects energy from plants using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

GIGAVOLT_HAVOC__PHYSICAL.name: Gigavolt Havoc
GIGAVOLT_HAVOC__PHYSICAL.effect: The user hits the target with a powerful electric current collected by its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

SHATTERED_PSYCHE__PHYSICAL.name: Shattered Psyche
SHATTERED_PSYCHE__PHYSICAL.effect: The user controls the target with its Z-Power and hurts the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

SUBZERO_SLAMMER__PHYSICAL.name: Subzero Slammer
SUBZERO_SLAMMER__PHYSICAL.effect: The user dramatically drops the temperature using its Z-Power and freezes the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

DEVASTATING_DRAKE__PHYSICAL.name: Devastating Drake
DEVASTATING_DRAKE__PHYSICAL.effect: The user materializes its aura using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

BLACK_HOLE_ECLIPSE__PHYSICAL.name: Black Hole Eclipse
BLACK_HOLE_ECLIPSE__PHYSICAL.effect: The user gathers dark energy using its Z-Power and sucks the target into it. The power varies, depending on the original move.

TWINKLE_TACKLE__PHYSICAL.name: Twinkle Tackle
TWINKLE_TACKLE__PHYSICAL.effect: The user creates a very charming space using its Z-Power and totally toys with the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.

CATASTROPIKA.name: Catastropika
CATASTROPIKA.effect: The user, Pikachu, surrounds itself with the maximum amount of electricity using its Z-Power and pounces on its target with full force.

SHORE_UP.name: Shore Up
SHORE_UP.effect: The user restores ½ of its max HP by kicking up a cloud of sand from its surroundings. In a sandstorm, the user restores ⅔ of its max HP instead.

FIRST_IMPRESSION.name: First Impression
FIRST_IMPRESSION.effect: The user attacks with tremendous power, but this move only succeeds if it is used first thing upon the user entering a battle.

BANEFUL_BUNKER.name: Baneful Bunker
BANEFUL_BUNKER.effect: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn become poisoned. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

SPIRIT_SHACKLE.name: Spirit Shackle
SPIRIT_SHACKLE.effect: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing or switching out of battle.

DARKEST_LARIAT.name: Darkest Lariat
DARKEST_LARIAT.effect: The user swings both arms and hits the target. This move ignores the target’s stat changes when dealing damage.

SPARKLING_ARIA.name: Sparkling Aria
SPARKLING_ARIA.effect: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.

ICE_HAMMER.name: Ice Hammer
ICE_HAMMER.effect: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Speed stat.

FLORAL_HEALING.name: Floral Healing
FLORAL_HEALING.effect: The user restores ½ of the target’s max HP. When the ground is Grassy Terrain, ⅔ of the target’s max HP is restored instead.

HIGH_HORSEPOWER.name: High Horsepower
HIGH_HORSEPOWER.effect: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

STRENGTH_SAP.name: Strength Sap
STRENGTH_SAP.effect: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target’s Attack stat. It then lowers the target’s Attack stat.

SOLAR_BLADE.name: Solar Blade
SOLAR_BLADE.effect: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light’s energy and attacks on the next turn. In harsh sunlight, the user can attack immediately. This move’s power is halved in any other weather condition.

LEAFAGE.name: Leafage
LEAFAGE.effect: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

SPOTLIGHT.name: Spotlight
SPOTLIGHT.effect: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.

TOXIC_THREAD.name: Toxic Thread
TOXIC_THREAD.effect: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and harshly lower the target’s Speed stat.

LASER_FOCUS.name: Laser Focus
LASER_FOCUS.effect: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

GEAR_UP.name: Gear Up
GEAR_UP.effect: The user engages its gears to boost the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.

THROAT_CHOP.name: Throat Chop
THROAT_CHOP.effect: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for 2 turns.

POLLEN_PUFF.name: Pollen Puff
POLLEN_PUFF.effect: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. When used on an ally, this move restores ½ of its max HP instead of dealing damage.

ANCHOR_SHOT.name: Anchor Shot
ANCHOR_SHOT.effect: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee or switched out of battle.

PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.name: Psychic Terrain
PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.effect: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for 5 turns.

LUNGE.name: Lunge
LUNGE.effect: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

FIRE_LASH.name: Fire Lash
FIRE_LASH.effect: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

POWER_TRIP.name: Power Trip
POWER_TRIP.effect: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the user’s stats have been boosted.

BURN_UP.name: Burn Up
BURN_UP.effect: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out and loses the Fire type. The user is thawed out if it is frozen. This move fails unless it is used by a Fire type.

SPEED_SWAP.name: Speed Swap
SPEED_SWAP.effect: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

SMART_STRIKE.name: Smart Strike
SMART_STRIKE.effect: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

PURIFY.name: Purify
PURIFY.effect: The user cures the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.

REVELATION_DANCE.name: Revelation Dance
REVELATION_DANCE.effect: The user attacks the target by dancing with all its might. This move becomes the same type as the user’s primary type.

CORE_ENFORCER.name: Core Enforcer
CORE_ENFORCER.effect: The user attacks by firing off a powerful beam that scorches across the battlefield. If the Pokémon damaged by this move have already used their moves that turn, this move eliminates the effects of those Pokémon’s Abilities.

TROP_KICK.name: Trop Kick
TROP_KICK.effect: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

INSTRUCT.name: Instruct
INSTRUCT.effect: The user instructs the target to reuse the move last used by the target.

BEAK_BLAST.name: Beak Blast
BEAK_BLAST.effect: The user first heats up its beak, and then it waits before attacking the target. Making direct contact with the user while it’s heating up its beak results in a burn.

CLANGING_SCALES.name: Clanging Scales
CLANGING_SCALES.effect: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user’s Defense stat is lowered after the attack.

DRAGON_HAMMER.name: Dragon Hammer
DRAGON_HAMMER.effect: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

BRUTAL_SWING.name: Brutal Swing
BRUTAL_SWING.effect: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

AURORA_VEIL.name: Aurora Veil
AURORA_VEIL.effect: This move halves the damage taken from physical and special moves for 5 turns. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead. This can be used only under hail or when it is snowing.

SINISTER_ARROW_RAID.name: Sinister Arrow Raid
SINISTER_ARROW_RAID.effect: The user, Decidueye, creates countless arrows using its Z-Power and shoots the target with full force.

MALICIOUS_MOONSAULT.name: Malicious Moonsault
MALICIOUS_MOONSAULT.effect: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body using its Z-Power and crashes into the target with full force.

OCEANIC_OPERETTA.name: Oceanic Operetta
OCEANIC_OPERETTA.effect: The user, Primarina, summons a massive amount of water using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force.

GUARDIAN_OF_ALOLA.name: Guardian of Alola
GUARDIAN_OF_ALOLA.effect: The user, the Land Spirit Pokémon, obtains Alola’s energy using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. This reduces the target’s HP greatly.

SOUL_STEALING_7_STAR_STRIKE.name: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike
SOUL_STEALING_7_STAR_STRIKE.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.

STOKED_SPARKSURFER.name: Stoked Sparksurfer
STOKED_SPARKSURFER.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force. This move leaves the target with paralysis.

PULVERIZING_PANCAKE.name: Pulverizing Pancake
PULVERIZING_PANCAKE.effect: Z-Power brings out the true capabilities of the user, Snorlax. The Pokémon moves its enormous body energetically and attacks the target with full force.

EXTREME_EVOBOOST.name: Extreme Evoboost
EXTREME_EVOBOOST.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts its stats sharply.

GENESIS_SUPERNOVA.name: Genesis Supernova
GENESIS_SUPERNOVA.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mew, attacks the target with full force. The terrain will be charged with psychic energy.

SHELL_TRAP.name: Shell Trap
SHELL_TRAP.effect: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.

FLEUR_CANNON.name: Fleur Cannon
FLEUR_CANNON.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a strong beam. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

PSYCHIC_FANGS.name: Psychic Fangs
PSYCHIC_FANGS.effect: The user attacks by biting targets using psychic power. This move can also break barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.

STOMPING_TANTRUM.name: Stomping Tantrum
STOMPING_TANTRUM.effect: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user couldn’t act, or its move missed or failed on the previous turn.

SHADOW_BONE.name: Shadow Bone
SHADOW_BONE.effect: The user attacks by beating targets with a bone in which a spirit resides. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

ACCELEROCK.name: Accelerock
ACCELEROCK.effect: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

LIQUIDATION.name: Liquidation
LIQUIDATION.effect: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

PRISMATIC_LASER.name: Prismatic Laser
PRISMATIC_LASER.effect: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can’t move on the next turn.

SPECTRAL_THIEF.name: Spectral Thief
SPECTRAL_THIEF.effect: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.

SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.name: Sunsteel Strike
SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.effect: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can ignore a target’s ability (with certain exceptions).

MOONGEIST_BEAM.name: Moongeist Beam
MOONGEIST_BEAM.effect: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can ignore a target’s ability (with certain exceptions).

TEARFUL_LOOK.name: Tearful Look
TEARFUL_LOOK.effect: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

ZING_ZAP.name: Zing Zap
ZING_ZAP.effect: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

NATURES_MADNESS.name: Nature’s Madness
NATURES_MADNESS.effect: The user hits the target with the full wrath of nature. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

MULTI_ATTACK.name: Multi-Attack
MULTI_ATTACK.effect: Cloaking itself in powerful energy, the user slams into the target to inflict damage. This move’s type changes depending on the kind of Memory Disc or Plate the user is holding, if it has the RKS System or Multitype ability.

TEN_MILLION_VOLT_THUNDERBOLT.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
TEN_MILLION_VOLT_THUNDERBOLT.effect: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 2 stages.

MIND_BLOWN.name: Mind Blown
MIND_BLOWN.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. After attacking, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

PLASMA_FISTS.name: Plasma Fists
PLASMA_FISTS.effect: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

PHOTON_GEYSER.name: Photon Geyser
PHOTON_GEYSER.effect: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability (with certain exceptions).

LIGHT_THAT_BURNS_THE_SKY.name: Light That Burns the Sky
LIGHT_THAT_BURNS_THE_SKY.effect: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user, Necrozma. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability (with certain exceptions).

SEARING_SUNRAZE_SMASH.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
SEARING_SUNRAZE_SMASH.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Solgaleo, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability (with certain exceptions).

MENACING_MOONRAZE_MAELSTROM.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
MENACING_MOONRAZE_MAELSTROM.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability (with certain exceptions).

LETS_SNUGGLE_FOREVER.name: Let’s Snuggle Forever
LETS_SNUGGLE_FOREVER.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.

SPLINTERED_STORMSHARDS.name: Splintered Stormshards
SPLINTERED_STORMSHARDS.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force. This move negates the effect on the battlefield.

CLANGOROUS_SOULBLAZE.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
CLANGOROUS_SOULBLAZE.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user’s stats.

ZIPPY_ZAP.name: Zippy Zap
ZIPPY_ZAP.effect: The user attacks the target with bursts of electricity at high speed. This move always goes first and results in a critical hit.

SPLISHY_SPLASH.name: Splishy Splash
SPLISHY_SPLASH.effect: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing targets.

FLOATY_FALL.name: Floaty Fall
FLOATY_FALL.effect: The user floats in the air, and then dives at a steep angle to attack the target. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

PIKA_PAPOW.name: Pika Papow
PIKA_PAPOW.effect: The more Pikachu loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 102). This attack never misses.

BOUNCY_BUBBLE.name: Bouncy Bubble
BOUNCY_BUBBLE.effect: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by 100% of the damage dealt by this move.

BUZZY_BUZZ.name: Buzzy Buzz
BUZZY_BUZZ.effect: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also paralyzes the target.

SIZZLY_SLIDE.name: Sizzly Slide
SIZZLY_SLIDE.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This also burns the target.

GLITZY_GLOW.name: Glitzy Glow
GLITZY_GLOW.effect: The user bombards the target with telekinetic force. A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from special moves. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

BADDY_BAD.name: Baddy Bad
BADDY_BAD.effect: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from physical moves. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

SAPPY_SEED.name: Sappy Seed
SAPPY_SEED.effect: The user grows a gigantic stalk that scatters seeds to attack the target. At the end of every turn, ⅛ of the target’s max HP gets absorbed by the user or any Pokémon that takes its place in battle.

FREEZY_FROST.name: Freezy Frost
FREEZY_FROST.effect: The user attacks with a crystal made of cold frozen haze. It eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

SPARKLY_SWIRL.name: Sparkly Swirl
SPARKLY_SWIRL.effect: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also cures the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

VEEVEE_VOLLEY.name: Veevee Volley
VEEVEE_VOLLEY.effect: The more Eevee loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 102). This attack never misses.

DOUBLE_IRON_BASH.name: Double Iron Bash
DOUBLE_IRON_BASH.effect: The user rotates, steeling itself with a spin, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. Each hit has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

MAX_GUARD.name: Max Guard
MAX_GUARD.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

DYNAMAX_CANNON.name: Dynamax Cannon
DYNAMAX_CANNON.effect: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage. Deals up to twice the damage if the target is overly leveled.

SNIPE_SHOT.name: Snipe Shot
SNIPE_SHOT.effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s moves and Abilities that draw in moves. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

JAW_LOCK.name: Jaw Lock
JAW_LOCK.effect: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

STUFF_CHEEKS.name: Stuff Cheeks
STUFF_CHEEKS.effect: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

NO_RETREAT.name: No Retreat
NO_RETREAT.effect: The user puts everything on the line and boosts its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats. In exchange, the user loses the ability to flee or be switched out of battle. Can only be used once per time the user enters battle.

TAR_SHOT.name: Tar Shot
TAR_SHOT.effect: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target’s Speed stat. Fire-type moves used on the target have their effectiveness doubled.

MAGIC_POWDER.name: Magic Powder
MAGIC_POWDER.effect: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target’s type to Psychic.

DRAGON_DARTS.name: Dragon Darts
DRAGON_DARTS.effect: The user attacks twice by launching draconic arrows. If there are 2 opposing Pokémon, each of them is attacked once.

TEATIME.name: Teatime
TEATIME.effect: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats a held Berry.

OCTOLOCK.name: Octolock
OCTOLOCK.effect: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing or switching out of battle. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.

BOLT_BEAK.name: Bolt Beak
BOLT_BEAK.effect: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. This move’s power is doubled if the user moves before the target.

FISHIOUS_REND.name: Fishious Rend
FISHIOUS_REND.effect: The user rends the target with its hard gills. This move’s power is doubled if the user moves before the target.

COURT_CHANGE.name: Court Change
COURT_CHANGE.effect: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

MAX_FLARE.name: Max Flare
MAX_FLARE.effect: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for 5 turns.

MAX_FLUTTERBY.name: Max Flutterby
MAX_FLUTTERBY.effect: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

MAX_LIGHTNING.name: Max Lightning
MAX_LIGHTNING.effect: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns.

MAX_STRIKE.name: Max Strike
MAX_STRIKE.effect: This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Speed stat.

MAX_KNUCKLE.name: Max Knuckle
MAX_KNUCKLE.effect: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This boosts ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.

MAX_PHANTASM.name: Max Phantasm
MAX_PHANTASM.effect: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Defense stat.

MAX_HAILSTORM.name: Max Hailstorm
MAX_HAILSTORM.effect: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting 5 turns.

MAX_OOZE.name: Max Ooze
MAX_OOZE.effect: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This boosts ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.

MAX_GEYSER.name: Max Geyser
MAX_GEYSER.effect: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for 5 turns.

MAX_AIRSTREAM.name: Max Airstream
MAX_AIRSTREAM.effect: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This boosts ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.

MAX_STARFALL.name: Max Starfall
MAX_STARFALL.effect: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for 5 turns.

MAX_WYRMWIND.name: Max Wyrmwind
MAX_WYRMWIND.effect: This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

MAX_MINDSTORM.name: Max Mindstorm
MAX_MINDSTORM.effect: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns.

MAX_ROCKFALL.name: Max Rockfall
MAX_ROCKFALL.effect: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting 5 turns.

MAX_QUAKE.name: Max Quake
MAX_QUAKE.effect: This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This boosts ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.

MAX_DARKNESS.name: Max Darkness
MAX_DARKNESS.effect: This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

MAX_OVERGROWTH.name: Max Overgrowth
MAX_OVERGROWTH.effect: This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns.

MAX_STEELSPIKE.name: Max Steelspike
MAX_STEELSPIKE.effect: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This boosts ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.

CLANGOROUS_SOUL.name: Clangorous Soul
CLANGOROUS_SOUL.effect: The user loses ⅓ of its max HP to boost its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

BODY_PRESS.name: Body Press
BODY_PRESS.effect: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The damage dealt by this move is determined using the user’s Defense stat instead of its Attack stat.

DECORATE.name: Decorate
DECORATE.effect: The user sharply boosts the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

DRUM_BEATING.name: Drum Beating
DRUM_BEATING.effect: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum’s roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

SNAP_TRAP.name: Snap Trap
SNAP_TRAP.effect: The user snares the target in a snap trap. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

PYRO_BALL.name: Pyro Ball
PYRO_BALL.effect: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

BEHEMOTH_BLADE.name: Behemoth Blade
BEHEMOTH_BLADE.effect: The user wields a large, powerful sword using its whole body and cuts the target in a vigorous attack.

BEHEMOTH_BASH.name: Behemoth Bash
BEHEMOTH_BASH.effect: The user’s body becomes a firm shield and slams into the target fiercely.

AURA_WHEEL.name: Aura Wheel
AURA_WHEEL.effect: The user attacks and boosts its Speed with the energy stored in its cheeks. When used by Morpeko, this move’s type changes depending on its form.

BREAKING_SWIPE.name: Breaking Swipe
BREAKING_SWIPE.effect: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

BRANCH_POKE.name: Branch Poke
BRANCH_POKE.effect: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

OVERDRIVE.name: Overdrive
OVERDRIVE.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with an electrifying soundwave, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

APPLE_ACID.name: Apple Acid
APPLE_ACID.effect: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

GRAV_APPLE.name: Grav Apple
GRAV_APPLE.effect: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat. This move’s power is boosted by 50% when Gravity is active.

SPIRIT_BREAK.name: Spirit Break
SPIRIT_BREAK.effect: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target’s spirit. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

STRANGE_STEAM.name: Strange Steam
STRANGE_STEAM.effect: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

LIFE_DEW.name: Life Dew
LIFE_DEW.effect: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores ¼ of the user and its ally Pokémon’s max HP.

OBSTRUCT.name: Obstruct
OBSTRUCT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn will have their Defense stats harshly lowered. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

FALSE_SURRENDER.name: False Surrender
FALSE_SURRENDER.effect: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

METEOR_ASSAULT.name: Meteor Assault
METEOR_ASSAULT.effect: The user attacks wildly with a long weapon. However, this also makes the user stagger, leaving it unable to move next turn.

ETERNABEAM.name: Eternabeam
ETERNABEAM.effect: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.

STEEL_BEAM.name: Steel Beam
STEEL_BEAM.effect: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. After attacking, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

EXPANDING_FORCE.name: Expanding Force
EXPANDING_FORCE.effect: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. If the user is under the effect of Psychic Terrain, this move’s power is boosted by 50% and its range extends to all opponents.

STEEL_ROLLER.name: Steel Roller
STEEL_ROLLER.effect: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn’t turned into a terrain.

SCALE_SHOT.name: Scale Shot
SCALE_SHOT.effect: The user attacks by shooting scales 2-5 times in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

METEOR_BEAM.name: Meteor Beam
METEOR_BEAM.effect: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

SHELL_SIDE_ARM.name: Shell Side Arm
SHELL_SIDE_ARM.effect: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This move has a 20% chance of poisoning the target.

MISTY_EXPLOSION.name: Misty Explosion
MISTY_EXPLOSION.effect: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. If the user is under the effect of Misty Terrain, this move’s power is boosted by 50%.

GRASSY_GLIDE.name: Grassy Glide
GRASSY_GLIDE.effect: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. If the user is under the effect of Grassy Terrain, this move always goes first.

RISING_VOLTAGE.name: Rising Voltage
RISING_VOLTAGE.effect: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move’s power is doubled if the target is under the effect of Electric Terrain.

TERRAIN_PULSE.name: Terrain Pulse
TERRAIN_PULSE.effect: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

SKITTER_SMACK.name: Skitter Smack
SKITTER_SMACK.effect: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

BURNING_JEALOUSY.name: Burning Jealousy
BURNING_JEALOUSY.effect: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

LASH_OUT.name: Lash Out
LASH_OUT.effect: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s stats were lowered during this turn.

POLTERGEIST.name: Poltergeist
POLTERGEIST.effect: The user attacks by controlling one of the target’s items. This move fails if the target isn’t holding any items.

CORROSIVE_GAS.name: Corrosive Gas
CORROSIVE_GAS.effect: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and disables items held by other Pokémon for the remainder of the battle.

COACHING.name: Coaching
COACHING.effect: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

FLIP_TURN.name: Flip Turn
FLIP_TURN.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

TRIPLE_AXEL.name: Triple Axel
TRIPLE_AXEL.effect: A consecutive three-kick attack that increases in power by 20 with each successive hit. When one kick misses, the move ends.

DUAL_WINGBEAT.name: Dual Wingbeat
DUAL_WINGBEAT.effect: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

SCORCHING_SANDS.name: Scorching Sands
SCORCHING_SANDS.effect: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.

JUNGLE_HEALING.name: Jungle Healing
JUNGLE_HEALING.effect: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring ¼ of the user and its ally Pokémon’s max HP while curing status conditions.

WICKED_BLOW.name: Wicked Blow
WICKED_BLOW.effect: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

SURGING_STRIKES.name: Surging Strikes
SURGING_STRIKES.effect: The user strikes the target with a flowing motion 3 times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

THUNDER_CAGE.name: Thunder Cage
THUNDER_CAGE.effect: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

DRAGON_ENERGY.name: Dragon Energy
DRAGON_ENERGY.effect: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

FREEZING_GLARE.name: Freezing Glare
FREEZING_GLARE.effect: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This move has a 10% chance of freezing the target.

FIERY_WRATH.name: Fiery Wrath
FIERY_WRATH.effect: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This move has a 20% chance of making targets flinch.

THUNDEROUS_KICK.name: Thunderous Kick
THUNDEROUS_KICK.effect: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

GLACIAL_LANCE.name: Glacial Lance
GLACIAL_LANCE.effect: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

ASTRAL_BARRAGE.name: Astral Barrage
ASTRAL_BARRAGE.effect: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

EERIE_SPELL.name: Eerie Spell
EERIE_SPELL.effect: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.

DIRE_CLAW.name: Dire Claw
DIRE_CLAW.effect: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This move has a 30% chance of leaving the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

PSYSHIELD_BASH.name: Psyshield Bash
PSYSHIELD_BASH.effect: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

POWER_SHIFT.name: Power Shift
POWER_SHIFT.effect: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

STONE_AXE.name: Stone Axe
STONE_AXE.effect: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target, damaging opposing Pokémon that switch into battle equal to ⅛ of their max HP. The stone splinters’ damage will differ depending on the Pokémon’s type matchup with the Rock type.

SPRINGTIDE_STORM.name: Springtide Storm
SPRINGTIDE_STORM.effect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the Attack stats of opposing Pokémon.

MYSTICAL_POWER.name: Mystical Power
MYSTICAL_POWER.effect: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

RAGING_FURY.name: Raging Fury
RAGING_FURY.effect: The user rampages around spewing flames for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

WAVE_CRASH.name: Wave Crash
WAVE_CRASH.effect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

CHLOROBLAST.name: Chloroblast
CHLOROBLAST.effect: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. After attacking, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

MOUNTAIN_GALE.name: Mountain Gale
MOUNTAIN_GALE.effect: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

VICTORY_DANCE.name: Victory Dance
VICTORY_DANCE.effect: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

HEADLONG_RUSH.name: Headlong Rush
HEADLONG_RUSH.effect: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

BARB_BARRAGE.name: Barb Barrage
BARB_BARRAGE.effect: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This move has a 50% chance of poisoning the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

ESPER_WING.name: Esper Wing
ESPER_WING.effect: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings, boosting its Speed stat. This move’s critical-hit ratio is also boosted by 1 stage.

BITTER_MALICE.name: Bitter Malice
BITTER_MALICE.effect: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

SHELTER.name: Shelter
SHELTER.effect: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

TRIPLE_ARROWS.name: Triple Arrows
TRIPLE_ARROWS.effect: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. This move’s critical-hit ratio is also boosted by 1 stage.

INFERNAL_PARADE.name: Infernal Parade
INFERNAL_PARADE.effect: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

CEASELESS_EDGE.name: Ceaseless Edge
CEASELESS_EDGE.effect: The user slashes a sharpened blade at the target, leaving splinters under the target as spikes. Pokémon that switch into battle take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP. Up to three layers can be set, with each layer increasing the damage taken. Flying types or Pokémon with Levitate are unaffected by these spikes.

BLEAKWIND_STORM.name: Bleakwind Storm
BLEAKWIND_STORM.effect: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon, and never misses in rain.

WILDBOLT_STORM.name: Wildbolt Storm
WILDBOLT_STORM.effect: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This move has a 20% chance of paralyzing targets, and never misses in rain.

SANDSEAR_STORM.name: Sandsear Storm
SANDSEAR_STORM.effect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This move has a 20% chance of burning targets, and never misses in rain.

LUNAR_BLESSING.name: Lunar Blessing
LUNAR_BLESSING.effect: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring ¼ of the user and its ally Pokémon’s max HP while curing status conditions.

TAKE_HEART.name: Take Heart
TAKE_HEART.effect: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

TERA_BLAST.name: Tera Blast
TERA_BLAST.effect: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

SILK_TRAP.name: Silk Trap
SILK_TRAP.effect: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

AXE_KICK.name: Axe Kick
AXE_KICK.effect: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target. If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP instead.

LAST_RESPECTS.name: Last Respects
LAST_RESPECTS.effect: The user attacks to avenge its allies. This move’s power is increased by 50 for each time that a Pokémon in the user’s party has fainted.

LUMINA_CRASH.name: Lumina Crash
LUMINA_CRASH.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

ORDER_UP.name: Order Up
ORDER_UP.effect: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts the user’s stats based on the Tatsugiri’s form: Attack for Curly Tatsugiri, Defense for Droopy, or Speed for Stretchy.

JET_PUNCH.name: Jet Punch
JET_PUNCH.effect: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

SPICY_EXTRACT.name: Spicy Extract
SPICY_EXTRACT.effect: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target’s Attack stat and harshly lowering the target’s Defense stat.

SPIN_OUT.name: Spin Out
SPIN_OUT.effect: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user’s Speed stat.

POPULATION_BOMB.name: Population Bomb
POPULATION_BOMB.effect: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target 1 to 10 times in a row. The attack ends if the user misses.

ICE_SPINNER.name: Ice Spinner
ICE_SPINNER.effect: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move’s spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

GLAIVE_RUSH.name: Glaive Rush
GLAIVE_RUSH.effect: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

REVIVAL_BLESSING.name: Revival Blessing
REVIVAL_BLESSING.effect: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon’s max HP.

SALT_CURE.name: Salt Cure
SALT_CURE.effect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of the target’s max HP at the end of every turn. Steel and Water types take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP instead.

TRIPLE_DIVE.name: Triple Dive
TRIPLE_DIVE.effect: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water 3 times in a row.

MORTAL_SPIN.name: Mortal Spin
MORTAL_SPIN.effect: The user performs a spin attack that can eliminate the effects of binding moves and Leech Seed, as well as any entry hazards on its side. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

DOODLE.name: Doodle
DOODLE.effect: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

FILLET_AWAY.name: Fillet Away
FILLET_AWAY.effect: The user loses ½ of its max HP to sharply boost its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

KOWTOW_CLEAVE.name: Kowtow Cleave
KOWTOW_CLEAVE.effect: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

FLOWER_TRICK.name: Flower Trick
FLOWER_TRICK.effect: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

TORCH_SONG.name: Torch Song
TORCH_SONG.effect: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

AQUA_STEP.name: Aqua Step
AQUA_STEP.effect: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

RAGING_BULL.name: Raging Bull
RAGING_BULL.effect: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect. When used by Tauros, this move’s type changes depending on its form.

MAKE_IT_RAIN.name: Make It Rain
MAKE_IT_RAIN.effect: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat. If a target is successfully struck, you will earn money after the battle.

PSYBLADE.name: Psyblade
PSYBLADE.effect: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the user is on Electric Terrain.

HYDRO_STEAM.name: Hydro Steam
HYDRO_STEAM.effect: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move’s power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50%.

RUINATION.name: Ruination
RUINATION.effect: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

COLLISION_COURSE.name: Collision Course
COLLISION_COURSE.effect: The user rushes forward and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

ELECTRO_DRIFT.name: Electro Drift
ELECTRO_DRIFT.effect: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

SHED_TAIL.name: Shed Tail
SHED_TAIL.effect: The user creates a substitute for itself using ½ of its max HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

CHILLY_RECEPTION.name: Chilly Reception
CHILLY_RECEPTION.effect: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns.

TIDY_UP.name: Tidy Up
TIDY_UP.effect: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

SNOWSCAPE.name: Snowscape
SNOWSCAPE.effect: The user summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

POUNCE.name: Pounce
POUNCE.effect: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

TRAILBLAZE.name: Trailblaze
TRAILBLAZE.effect: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user’s nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

CHILLING_WATER.name: Chilling Water
CHILLING_WATER.effect: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that’s so cold it saps the target’s power. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

HYPER_DRILL.name: Hyper Drill
HYPER_DRILL.effect: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

TWIN_BEAM.name: Twin Beam
TWIN_BEAM.effect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

RAGE_FIST.name: Rage Fist
RAGE_FIST.effect: The user attacks by converting its rage into energy. This move’s power is increased by 50 each time the user takes damage from a move, up to a maximum power of 350. If the user switches out of battle, the move’s power returns to its usual value.

ARMOR_CANNON.name: Armor Cannon
ARMOR_CANNON.effect: The user attacks by shooting off its own armor as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

BITTER_BLADE.name: Bitter Blade
BITTER_BLADE.effect: The user attacks by focusing all its bitter feelings toward this world into a slashing attack. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

DOUBLE_SHOCK.name: Double Shock
DOUBLE_SHOCK.effect: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack, and loses the Electric type. This move fails unless it is used by a Electric type.

GIGATON_HAMMER.name: Gigaton Hammer
GIGATON_HAMMER.effect: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

COMEUPPANCE.name: Comeuppance
COMEUPPANCE.effect: The user retaliates to deal 1.5x of the damage it took from an opponent’s move during the turn this move is used.

AQUA_CUTTER.name: Aqua Cutter
AQUA_CUTTER.effect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

BLAZING_TORQUE.name: Blazing Torque
BLAZING_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with blazing energy. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target.

WICKED_TORQUE.name: Wicked Torque
WICKED_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with malicious intent. This move has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep.

NOXIOUS_TORQUE.name: Noxious Torque
NOXIOUS_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with a poisonous end. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

COMBAT_TORQUE.name: Combat Torque
COMBAT_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with great force. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

MAGICAL_TORQUE.name: Magical Torque
MAGICAL_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with a fae-like force. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target.

BLOOD_MOON.name: Blood Moon
BLOOD_MOON.effect: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

MATCHA_GOTCHA.name: Matcha Gotcha
MATCHA_GOTCHA.effect: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move, and has a 20% chance of burning targets. This will also thaw out a frozen user or target.

SYRUP_BOMB.name: Syrup Bomb
SYRUP_BOMB.effect: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target’s Speed stat to drop at the end of every turn for 3 turns.

IVY_CUDGEL.name: Ivy Cudgel
IVY_CUDGEL.effect: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel, this move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage. When used by Ogerpon, this move’s type changes depending on the mask worn.

ELECTRO_SHOT.name: Electro Shot
ELECTRO_SHOT.effect: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

TERA_STARSTORM.name: Tera Starstorm
TERA_STARSTORM.effect: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user when Terastallized.

FICKLE_BEAM.name: Fickle Beam
FICKLE_BEAM.effect: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. There is a 30% chance that all of the user’s heads will shoot beams in unison, doubling the move’s power.

BURNING_BULWARK.name: Burning Bulwark
BURNING_BULWARK.effect: The user intensely heats up a part of its body, protecting it from attacks and also causing burns to any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

THUNDERCLAP.name: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.effect: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

MIGHTY_CLEAVE.name: Mighty Cleave
MIGHTY_CLEAVE.effect: The user wields the light that has accumulated through its blades to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

TACHYON_CUTTER.name: Tachyon Cutter
TACHYON_CUTTER.effect: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

HARD_PRESS.name: Hard Press
HARD_PRESS.effect: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 100).

DRAGON_CHEER.name: Dragon Cheer
DRAGON_CHEER.effect: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. Dragon types receive a 2-stage boost. All other types receive a 1-stage boost.

ALLURING_VOICE.name: Alluring Voice
ALLURING_VOICE.effect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

TEMPER_FLARE.name: Temper Flare
TEMPER_FLARE.effect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s previous move failed.

SUPERCELL_SLAM.name: Supercell Slam
SUPERCELL_SLAM.effect: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. The user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP if this move misses or fails. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

PSYCHIC_NOISE.name: Psychic Noise
PSYCHIC_NOISE.effect: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For 2 turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

UPPER_HAND.name: Upper Hand
UPPER_HAND.effect: The user reacts to the target’s movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

MALIGNANT_CHAIN.name: Malignant Chain
MALIGNANT_CHAIN.effect: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This move has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.

NIHIL_LIGHT.name: Nihil Light
NIHIL_LIGHT.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a powerful light that defies all laws of nature, striking even Fairy types and ignoring any stat changes affecting its targets.

STENCH.name: Stench
STENCH.description: By releasing a stench when attacking, there is a 10% chance that targets damaged by the Pokémon’s moves will flinch. This does not stack with moves or items that have a chance to flinch.

DRIZZLE.name: Drizzle
DRIZZLE.description: The Pokémon makes it rain for 5 turns when it enters a battle.

SPEED_BOOST.name: Speed Boost
SPEED_BOOST.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat at the end of every turn.

BATTLE_ARMOR.name: Battle Armor
BATTLE_ARMOR.description: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

STURDY.name: Sturdy
STURDY.description: If the Pokémon has full HP and takes damage from a move that would knock it out in one hit, it will endure the hit with 1 HP. The Pokémon is also immune to one-hit KO moves.

DAMP.name: Damp
DAMP.description: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct or dealing damage with Aftermath.

LIMBER.name: Limber
LIMBER.description: The Pokémon’s limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

SAND_VEIL.name: Sand Veil
SAND_VEIL.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

STATIC.name: Static
STATIC.description: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and has a 30% chance to paralyze attackers that hit it with a contact move.

VOLT_ABSORB.name: Volt Absorb
VOLT_ABSORB.description: Electric-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore ¼ of its max HP.

WATER_ABSORB.name: Water Absorb
WATER_ABSORB.description: Water-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore ¼ of its max HP.

OBLIVIOUS.name: Oblivious
OBLIVIOUS.description: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

COMPOUND_EYES.name: Compound Eyes
COMPOUND_EYES.description: The Pokémon’s compound eyes boost its accuracy by 30%.

INSOMNIA.name: Insomnia
INSOMNIA.description: The Pokémon’s insomnia prevents it from becoming drowsy or being put to sleep.

COLOR_CHANGE.name: Color Change
COLOR_CHANGE.description: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

IMMUNITY.name: Immunity
IMMUNITY.description: The Pokémon’s immune system prevents it from being poisoned or badly poisoned.

FLASH_FIRE.name: Flash Fire
FLASH_FIRE.description: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves by 50%.

SHIELD_DUST.name: Shield Dust
SHIELD_DUST.description: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

OWN_TEMPO.name: Own Tempo
OWN_TEMPO.description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

SUCTION_CUPS.name: Suction Cups
SUCTION_CUPS.description: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

INTIMIDATE.name: Intimidate
INTIMIDATE.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

SHADOW_TAG.name: Shadow Tag
SHADOW_TAG.description: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon’s shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

ROUGH_SKIN.name: Rough Skin
ROUGH_SKIN.description: The Pokémon’s rough skin damages attackers that hit it with contact moves for ⅛ of their max HP.

WONDER_GUARD.name: Wonder Guard
WONDER_GUARD.description: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

LEVITATE.name: Levitate
LEVITATE.description: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web.

EFFECT_SPORE.name: Effect Spore
EFFECT_SPORE.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep.

SYNCHRONIZE.name: Synchronize
SYNCHRONIZE.description: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, poisoned, or badly poisoned by another Pokémon’s move or Ability, that Pokémon will also be inflicted with the same status condition. If this Pokémon is your lead into battle, opposing wild Pokémon will share its nature.

CLEAR_BODY.name: Clear Body
CLEAR_BODY.description: The Pokémon’s stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

NATURAL_CURE.name: Natural Cure
NATURAL_CURE.description: The Pokémon’s status conditions are cured when it switches out of battle.

LIGHTNING_ROD.name: Lightning Rod
LIGHTNING_ROD.description: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. These moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat.

SERENE_GRACE.name: Serene Grace
